```html
        .admin-progreso-page .panel-card,
        .admin-progreso-page .module-summary-card,
        .admin-progreso-page .participant-card {
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .metric-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .metric-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .metric-icon {
            width: 52px;
            height: 52px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .metric-value {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .metric-label {
            margin: var(--spacing-1) 0 0;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .admin-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            gap: var(--spacing-xl);
            align-items: start;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .panel-stack {
            display: grid;
            gap: var(--spacing-xl);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .panel-card,
        .admin-progreso-page .module-summary-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .panel-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .panel-header h2 {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .toolbar {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 180px 180px auto;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
            align-items: flex-end;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .form-field {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .form-label {
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .form-input,
        .admin-progreso-page .form-select {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 48px;
            padding: var(--spacing-sm) var(--spacing-md);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-medium);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid transparent;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family-body);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
            transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .form-input:focus,
        .admin-progreso-page .form-select:focus {
            outline: none;
            background: var(--color-white);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-primary);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .btn-admin-secondary {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
            min-height: 44px;
            padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            text-decoration: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .btn-admin-secondary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .table-wrap {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow-x: auto;
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            position: relative;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table {
            width: 100%;
            min-width: 1000px;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            table-layout: fixed; /* Forzar control de anchos */
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th,
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table td {
            padding: var(--spacing-md);
            border-bottom: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            text-align: left;
            vertical-align: middle;
            background: inherit;
        }

        /* Columna de acciones sticky */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:last-child,
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table td:last-child {
            position: sticky;
            right: 0;
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            z-index: 2;
            box-shadow: -4px 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
            min-width: 130px;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:last-child {
            z-index: 3;
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th {
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* Anchos específicos de columna para fluidez */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(1) { width: 25%; } /* Participante */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(2) { width: 15%; } /* Rol */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(3) { width: 10%; } /* Ubicación */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(4) { width: 10%; } /* Estado */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(5),
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(6),
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(7) { width: 8%; }  /* Módulos */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(8) { width: 10%; } /* Actividad */
        .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th:nth-child(9) { width: 120px; } /* Acciones */

        .admin-progreso-page .participant-name {
            display: block;
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .participant-email {
            display: block;
            margin-top: var(--spacing-1);
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
        }

        /* --- RESPONSIVIDAD DE TABLA (CARDS EN MÓVIL) --- */
        @media (max-width: 992px) {
            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table, 
            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table thead, 
            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table tbody, 
            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table th, 
            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table td, 
            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table tr { 
                display: block; 
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table {
                min-width: 100% !important;
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table thead {
                display: none; /* Ocultar cabecera en móvil */
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table tr {
                margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
                padding: var(--spacing-lg);
                background: var(--color-background-surface);
                border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default);
                border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
                box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table td {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: space-between;
                align-items: center;
                padding: var(--spacing-2) 0;
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-background-surface-low);
                text-align: right;
                background: none !important;
                position: static !important;
                box-shadow: none !important;
                min-width: 0 !important;
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table td:first-child {
                border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border-default);
                padding-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
                margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
                text-align: left;
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table td:last-child {
                border-bottom: 0;
                margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
                padding-top: var(--spacing-md);
                justify-content: center;
            }

            /* Inyectar etiquetas para los datos */
            .admin-progreso-page .progress-table td:not(:first-child):not(:last-child)::before {
                content: attr(data-label);
                float: left;
                font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
                color: var(--color-text-muted);
                text-transform: uppercase;
                font-size: 10px;
                letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .btn-admin-secondary {
                width: 100%;
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .scroll-hint {
                display: none !important;
            }
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .participant-avatar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            background: var(--color-brand-secondary-light);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-md);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .badge-soft {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-1);
            padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .badge-important {
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            color: var(--color-white);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-cell {
            min-width: 180px;
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-label-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: var(--spacing-sm);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-2);
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-native {
            width: 100%;
            height: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 0;
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-native::-webkit-progress-bar {
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-native::-webkit-progress-value {
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .progress-native::-moz-progress-bar {
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .participants-grid {
            display: none;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .participant-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-lg);
            transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .participant-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .participant-card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .participant-avatar {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--gradient-cyan);
            color: var(--color-white);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .module-summary-list {
            display: grid;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .module-summary-item {
            padding: var(--spacing-md);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .module-summary-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .activity-list {
            display: grid;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .activity-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            padding: var(--spacing-md);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
        }

        .admin-progreso-page .activity-dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            flex: 0 0 12px;
            margin-top: var(--spacing-2);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
        }

        @media (max-width: 1120px) {
            .admin-progreso-page .admin-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .metrics-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .admin-progreso-page .toolbar {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .admin-progreso-page .admin-shell,
            .admin-progreso-page .panel-card,
            .admin-progreso-page .metric-card {
                padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .admin-title {
                font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .table-wrap {
                display: block;
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .participants-grid {
                display: grid;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 520px) {
            .admin-progreso-page .admin-wrapper {
                padding: 0 var(--spacing-sm);
            }

            .admin-progreso-page .metrics-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* Estilos para el botón de reinicio */
        .btn-admin-danger-outline {
            background: none;
            border: 1px solid var(--color-feedback-error);
            color: var(--color-feedback-error);
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .btn-admin-danger-outline:hover:not(:disabled) {
            background: var(--color-feedback-error-container);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }
        
        .btn-sync-full {
            width: 100% !important;
        }

        .btn-admin-danger-outline:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            border-color: var(--color-border-subtle);
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
        }
        /* Estilos de Navegación Superior (Fix para Widget) */
        .top-nav {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: var(--height-module-topnav, 80px);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-default);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 var(--spacing-xl);
            z-index: 1000;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs);
        }
        .nav-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
        }
        .logo-container img {
            height: 40px;
            width: auto;
        }
        .module-title-nav {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--color-text-display);
        }

        /* Modal de Detalle Pedagógico */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--color-alpha-black-70);
            z-index: 1000;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm));
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm));
        }

        .modal-container {
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 900px;
            max-height: 90vh;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            overflow-y: auto;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
        }

        .modal-close-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: var(--spacing-5);
            right: var(--spacing-5);
            background: none;
            border: none;
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
            cursor: pointer;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
        }

        .modal-footer-bar {
            padding: var(--spacing-5);
            text-align: right;
            border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body class="admin-progreso-page">
    <nav class="top-nav" aria-label="Navegación superior administrativa">
        <div class="nav-left">
            <button class="menu-btn" type="button" onclick="toggleSidebar()" aria-label="Abrir menú de navegación"
                aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sidebar">
                <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                    stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
                    <line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"></line>
                    <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"></line>
                    <line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"></line>
                </svg>
            </button>
            <div class="logo-container">
                <img data-assets="LLM_Docencia_4.0_logo.png" src="assets/LLM_Docencia_4.0_logo.png"
                    alt="Logo Docencia 4.0">
            </div>
            <span class="module-title-nav">Administrar Progreso</span>
        </div>
        <div id="admin-notification-widget" style="display: flex; margin-left: auto;"></div>
    </nav>


    <div class="module-sidebar-overlay" id="overlay" onclick="closeSidebar()" aria-hidden="true"></div>

    <aside class="module-sidebar" id="sidebar" aria-label="Menú del panel administrativo" aria-hidden="true">
        <h2 class="side-menu-title">Administración</h2>
        <ul class="menu-links">
            <li><a href="dashboard.html">🏠 Dashboard del curso</a></li>
            <li><span class="menu-section-label">Panel LMS</span></li>
            <li><a href="admin_dashboard.html">⚙️ Centro de control</a></li>
            <li><a href="admin_anuncios.html">📢 Anuncios</a></li>
            <li><a href="admin_usuarios.html">👥 Usuarios</a></li>
            <li><a href="admin_accesos.html">🔐 Accesos</a></li>
            <li><a href="admin_progreso.html" class="active" aria-current="page">📈 Progreso</a></li>
            <li><a href="admin_foros.html">💬 Foros</a></li>
            <li><a href="admin_configuracion.html">🧩 Configuración</a></li>
            <li><span class="menu-section-label">Vista participante</span></li>
            <li><a href="anuncios.html">📢 Leer anuncios</a></li>
            <li><a href="foro_general.html">💬 Foro general</a></li>
            <li><a href="perfil.html">👤 Mi perfil</a></li>
        </ul>
    </aside>

    <main class="admin-wrapper">
        <article class="admin-shell" aria-labelledby="admin-title">
            <header class="admin-header">
                <span class="admin-kicker">Panel administrativo · Docencia 4.0</span>
                <h1 id="admin-title" class="admin-title">Administrar <span>Progreso</span></h1>
                <p class="admin-description">Monitorea el avance de los participantes por módulo, revisa última
                    actividad, estado de finalización y participación general dentro del LMS.</p>
            </header>

            <div id="statusMessage" class="status-message" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

            <section class="metrics-grid" aria-label="Métricas generales de progreso">
                <article class="metric-card">
                    <div class="metric-icon" aria-hidden="true">👥</div>
                    <p id="metricParticipants" class="metric-value">0</p>
                    <p class="metric-label">Participantes monitoreados</p>
                </article>
                <article class="metric-card">
                    <div class="metric-icon" aria-hidden="true">📈</div>
                    <p id="metricAverage" class="metric-value">0%</p>
                    <p class="metric-label">Progreso promedio</p>
                </article>
                <article class="metric-card">
                    <div class="metric-icon" aria-hidden="true">✅</div>
                    <p id="metricCompleted" class="metric-value">0</p>
                    <p class="metric-label">Participantes completados</p>
                </article>
                <article class="metric-card">
                    <div class="metric-icon" aria-hidden="true">⏱️</div>
                    <p id="metricActiveToday" class="metric-value">0</p>
                    <p class="metric-label">Activos hoy</p>
                </article>
            </section>

            <section class="admin-grid" aria-label="Seguimiento de progreso">
                <div class="panel-stack">
                    <section class="panel-card" aria-labelledby="progress-list-title">
                        <div class="panel-header">
                            <div>
                                <h2 id="progress-list-title">Progreso por participante</h2>
                                <p>Filtra por nombre, módulo actual, estado o cohorte para identificar avances y
                                    rezagos.</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="toolbar" aria-label="Filtros de progreso">
                            <div class="form-field">
                                <label for="searchParticipants" class="form-label">Buscar</label>
                                <input id="searchParticipants" class="form-input" type="search"
                                    placeholder="Buscar por nombre o email">
                            </div>
                            <div class="form-field">
                                <label for="moduleFilter" class="form-label">Módulo</label>
                                <select id="moduleFilter" class="form-select">
                                    <option value="all">Todos</option>
                                    <option value="modulo1">Módulo 1</option>
                                    <option value="modulo2">Módulo 2</option>
                                    <option value="modulo3">Módulo 3</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <div class="form-field">
                                <label for="statusFilter" class="form-label">Estado</label>
                                <select id="statusFilter" class="form-select">
                                    <option value="all">Todos</option>
                                    <option value="not_started">No iniciado</option>
                                    <option value="in_progress">En progreso</option>
                                    <option value="completed">Completado</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <div class="form-field">
                                <label class="form-label">&nbsp;</label>
                                <button class="btn-admin-secondary btn-sync-full" onclick="runProgressSync()" title="Sincroniza el progreso histórico con el nuevo monitor en tiempo real">
                                    🔄 Sincronizar Métricas
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
                                <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 8L22 12L18 16"/><path d="M6 8L2 12L6 16"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/></svg>
                                Desliza para ver acciones
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="table-wrap" aria-label="Tabla de progreso por participante">
                            <table class="progress-table">
                                <thead>
                                    <tr>
                                        <th>Participante</th>
                                        <th>Rol/Contexto</th>
                                        <th>Ubicación</th>
                                        <th>Estado</th>
                                        <th>Módulo 1</th>
                                        <th>Módulo 2</th>

    <!-- Modal de Detalle Pedagógico -->
    <div id="detailModal" class="modal-overlay" style="display: none;">

    <a href="#" class="btn-scroll-top" id="scrollTopBtn" aria-label="Subir al inicio de la página">↑</a>

        import { initAdminNotifications } from './scripts/admin-notifications-widget-v2.js';
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => initAdminNotifications());
        } else {
            initAdminNotifications();
        }
    </script>
    <div id="institutional-footer"></div>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/institutional-footer.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <script>
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
        const menuBtn = document.querySelector('.menu-btn');
        const scrollTopBtn = document.getElementById('scrollTopBtn');

        function openSidebar() {
            sidebar?.classList.add('active');
            overlay?.classList.add('active');
            menuBtn?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }

        function closeSidebar() {
            sidebar?.classList.remove('active');
            overlay?.classList.remove('active');
            menuBtn?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        }

        function toggleSidebar() {
            sidebar?.classList.contains('active') ? closeSidebar() : openSidebar();
        }

        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.scrollY > 300) {
                scrollTopBtn?.classList.add('visible');
            } else {
                scrollTopBtn?.classList.remove('visible');
            }
        });

        scrollTopBtn?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });

        function resolveAssetPath(img) {
            const rawAssets = img.dataset.assets || img.dataset.asset;
            if (!rawAssets) return;
            const fileNames = rawAssets.split('|').map(item => item.trim());
            const bases = ['./assets/', 'assets/', '../assets/', '/assets/'];
            let index = 0;
            const tryNext = () => {
                if (index < bases.length) {
                    img.src = bases[index] + fileNames[0];
                    index++;
                }
            };
            img.onerror = tryNext;
            tryNext();
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('img[data-assets], img[data-asset]').forEach(resolveAssetPath);
    </script>

    <script type="module" src="scripts/institutional-footer.js"></script>
```

```html
        .module-card-refined {

            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),

        }

            }

        .module-breakdown {

        }

                padding: 0 var(--spacing-md);
            }

                font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
            }
        }

                <div class="intro-content">
                    <h2 id="programa-title" class="section-title section-title-md">Programa de Formación Profesional en
                        LLM y de Bots o Aplicaciones que los Integran</h2>

                    <div class="highlight-box">
                        <h3>Objetivo General</h3>
                        <p>Capacitar a los y las docentes en el uso instrumental, ético y pedagógico de Modelos
                            de Lenguaje de Gran Tamaño (LLM) y de bots o aplicaciones que los integran para optimizar
                            los procesos de planificación didáctica, evaluación de aprendizajes y gestión
                            administrativa, reduciendo el tiempo operativo y mejorando la calidad de la
                            retroalimentación educativa.</p>
                    </div>

                    <h3 class="section-title section-title-sm">Objetivos Específicos</h3>
                    <div class="objectives-list">
                        <div class="objective-card">
                            <strong>Conceptuales:</strong> Definir con precisión qué es un LLM (tecnología base) y qué
                            es un bot o app que utiliza un LLM, así como sus capacidades, limitaciones (incluidas las
                            alucinaciones) y consideraciones éticas según las normativas de integridad académica.
                        </div>
                        <div class="objective-card">
                            <strong>Procedimentales:</strong> Diseñar prompts (instrucciones) efectivos para, mediante
                            bots o apps con LLM, generar planes diarios, rúbricas de evaluación diferenciadas y
                            materiales didácticos adaptados.
                        </div>
                        <div class="objective-card">
                            <strong>Actitudinales:</strong> Desarrollar una percepción positiva de autoeficacia
                            tecnológica, transitando de la resistencia al uso estratégico de la IA, comprendiendo la
                            diferencia entre LLM y bot, como apoyo en la gestión docente.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

            <section class="theory-section" aria-labelledby="fundamentos-title">

                </h3>
                <p class="theory-intro">Este currículo responde a la necesidad crítica de modernizar la gestión docente
                    y aliviar la sobrecarga administrativa identificada en el sistema educativo de Puerto Rico. Se
                    fundamenta en:</p>

                <div class="theory-grid">
                    <article class="theory-card">
                        <h4>Teoría Sociocultural (Vygotsky)</h4>
                        <p>Los LLM actúan como andamiaje (scaffolding) cognitivo, permitiendo al docente operar en una
                            Zona de Desarrollo Próximo superior en tareas de planificación y evaluación.</p>
                    </article>
                    <article class="theory-card">
                        <h4>Modelo de Aceptación Tecnológica (TAM)</h4>
                        <p>El diseño de los talleres se enfoca explícitamente en demostrar la Utilidad Percibida y la
                            Facilidad de Uso para garantizar la adopción.</p>
                    </article>
                    <article class="theory-card">
                        <h4>Capital Profesional (Hargreaves &amp; Fullan)</h4>
                        <p>Se busca aumentar el capital decisional del docente, liberando tiempo de tareas repetitivas
                            para invertirlo en la pedagogía.</p>
                    </article>
                </div>
            </section>
        </section>

        const MODULES_DATA = [
            {
                id: 1,
                title: "Fundamentos, potencial pedagógico y ética de los LLM en la gestión docente",
                lessons: 8,
                image: "assets/icon_modulo1.png",
                url: "modulo1_intro.html"

            {

                lessons: 7,
                image: "assets/icon_modulo2.png",
                url: "modulo2_intro.html"
            },
            {
                id: 3,
                title: "Gestión administrativa y evaluativa: Eficiencia operativa en el rol docente",
                lessons: 8,
                image: "assets/icon_modulo3.png",
                url: "modulo3_intro.html"
            }
        ];

        const video = document.getElementById('welcomeVideo');
        const muteButton = document.getElementById('muteBtn');
        const zoomModal = document.getElementById('zoomModal');
        const zoomedImg = document.getElementById('zoomedImg');
        const mainIllustration = document.getElementById('mainIllustration');
        let lastFocusedElement = null;

        function resolveAssetPath(img) {
            const rawAssets = img.dataset.assets || img.dataset.asset;
            if (!rawAssets) return;

            const fileNames = rawAssets
                .split('|')
                .map((item) => item.trim())
                .filter(Boolean);

            const paths = [];
            const bases = ['./assets/', 'assets/', '../assets/', '../../assets/', '../../../assets/', '/assets/'];

            fileNames.forEach((fileName) => {
                const encodedFileName = fileName
                    .split('/')
                    .map((part) => encodeURIComponent(part))
                    .join('/');

                bases.forEach((base) => {
                    paths.push(`${base}${fileName}`);
                    paths.push(`${base}${encodedFileName}`);
                });
            });

            const uniqueCandidates = [...new Set(paths)];
            let index = 0;

            img.onerror = () => {
                if (index < uniqueCandidates.length) {
                    img.src = uniqueCandidates[index];
                    index += 1;
                } else {
                    img.onerror = null;
                    console.warn(`No se pudo cargar la imagen. Verifica que exista en assets y que el nombre coincida exactamente con alguno de estos: ${fileNames.join(', ')}`);
                }
            };

            if (uniqueCandidates.length > 0) {
                img.src = uniqueCandidates[index];
                index += 1;
            }
        }

        function renderDashboard() {
            const container = document.getElementById('modules-grid-container');
            if (!container) return;

            container.textContent = '';

            MODULES_DATA.forEach((mod) => {
                const article = document.createElement('article');
                article.className = 'module-card-refined';
                article.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `module-title-${mod.id}`);

                const imageContainer = document.createElement('div');
                imageContainer.className = 'module-image-container';

                const image = document.createElement('img');
                image.src = mod.image;
                image.alt = `Ícono del módulo ${mod.id}`;
                image.className = 'module-image';
                image.dataset.assets = `icon_modulo${mod.id}.png|LLM_Docencia_4.0_logo.png`;
                resolveAssetPath(image);
                imageContainer.appendChild(image);

                const content = document.createElement('div');
                content.className = 'module-content';

                const number = document.createElement('div');
                number.className = 'module-number-prominent';
                number.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                number.textContent = `Módulo ${mod.id}`;

                const title = document.createElement('h3');
                title.id = `module-title-${mod.id}`;
                title.className = 'module-title-refined';
                title.textContent = mod.title;

                // Contenedor de desglose (Placeholder)
                const breakdown = document.createElement('div');
                breakdown.className = 'module-breakdown';
                breakdown.id = `breakdown-${mod.id}`;
                breakdown.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="breakdown-item"><span>📖 Contenido formativo</span><span>-</span></div>
                    <div class="breakdown-item"><span>📝 Actividades</span><span>-</span></div>
                    <div class="breakdown-item"><span>💬 Foro revisado</span><span>-</span></div>
                    <div class="breakdown-item"><span>📚 Recursos revisados</span><span>-</span></div>
                `;

                // Siguiente paso (Placeholder)
                const nextStep = document.createElement('div');
                nextStep.className = 'next-step-container';
                nextStep.id = `next-step-${mod.id}`;
                nextStep.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="next-step-label">Siguiente paso sugerido</span>
                    <span class="next-step-title">Cargando...</span>
                `;

                const footer = document.createElement('div');
                footer.className = 'module-footer';

                const stats = document.createElement('div');
                stats.className = 'module-stats';

                const progressText = document.createElement('span');
                progressText.textContent = '0% completado';
                stats.append(document.createElement('span'), progressText);

                const progress = document.createElement('div');
                progress.className = 'progress';
                progress.setAttribute('aria-label', `Progreso del módulo ${mod.id}: 0% completado`);

                const progressFill = document.createElement('div');
                progressFill.className = 'progress-fill';
                progressFill.style.width = '0%';
                progress.appendChild(progressFill);

                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = mod.url;
                link.id = `btn-action-${mod.id}`;
                link.className = 'btn btn-primary btn-continuar';
                link.setAttribute('aria-label', `Comenzar el módulo ${mod.id}: ${mod.title}`);
                link.textContent = 'Comenzar';

                footer.append(stats, progress, link);
                content.append(number, title, breakdown, nextStep, footer);
                article.append(imageContainer, content);
                container.appendChild(article);
            });
        }

        function toggleMute() {
            if (!video || !muteButton) return;

            video.muted = !video.muted;
            muteButton.textContent = video.muted ? '🔈' : '🔊';
            muteButton.setAttribute(
                'aria-label',
                video.muted ? 'Activar audio del video de bienvenida' : 'Silenciar audio del video de bienvenida'
            );
        }

        function openZoom() {
            if (!zoomModal || !zoomedImg || !mainIllustration) return;

            lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
            zoomedImg.src = mainIllustration.currentSrc || mainIllustration.src;
            zoomModal.classList.add('is-open');
            zoomModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

            const closeButton = zoomModal.querySelector('.modal-close-btn');
            if (closeButton) closeButton.focus();
        }

        function closeZoom() {
            if (!zoomModal) return;

            zoomModal.classList.remove('is-open');
            zoomModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';

            if (lastFocusedElement && typeof lastFocusedElement.focus === 'function') {
                lastFocusedElement.focus();
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            document.querySelectorAll('img[data-assets], img[data-asset]').forEach(resolveAssetPath);
            renderDashboard();

            // Manejo de scroll para header sticky
            const header = document.querySelector('.dashboard-header');
            if (header) {
                window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                    if (window.scrollY > 20) {
                        header.classList.add('is-scrolled');
                    } else {
                        header.classList.remove('is-scrolled');
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            // Verificador de acceso administrativo (Carmelo)
            import("./scripts/firebase-config.js").then(config => {
                import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js").then(authMod => {
                    authMod.onAuthStateChanged(config.auth, (user) => {
                        if (user && user.email === "carmelo.allende@gmail.com") {
                            const adminLink = document.getElementById('adminDashboardLink');
                            if (adminLink) adminLink.style.display = 'flex';
                        }
                    });
                });
            });
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (!video || !muteButton) return;

            if (video.muted) {
                video.muted = false;
                video.play().catch(() => { });
                muteButton.textContent = '🔊';
                muteButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Silenciar audio del video de bienvenida');
            }
        }, { once: true });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape' && zoomModal && zoomModal.classList.contains('is-open')) {
                closeZoom();
            }
        });

        zoomModal?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            if (event.target === zoomModal) {
                closeZoom();
            }
        });
    </script>

    <style>


        @keyframes slideIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
    </style>

    <script type="module">
        import { auth } from "./scripts/firebase-config.js";
        import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
        import { getVisibleAnnouncements, getUserReadStatus, markAsRead } from "./scripts/announcement-service.js";
        import { getUserProfile } from "./scripts/user-service.js";
        import { getModuleDetailedProgress } from "./scripts/progress-service.js";
        import { subscribeToUnreadNotifications, subscribeToRecentNotifications, markNotificationAsRead, archiveNotification } from "./scripts/notification-service.js";

        let unsubscribeUnread = null;
        let unsubscribeRecent = null;
        let firestoreUnreadCount = 0;
        let firestoreNotifications = [];
        let virtualAnnouncements = [];

        onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
             // Limpieza si el usuario sale
             if (!user) {
                 if (unsubscribeUnread) unsubscribeUnread();
                 if (unsubscribeRecent) unsubscribeRecent();
                 unsubscribeUnread = null;
                 unsubscribeRecent = null;
                 firestoreUnreadCount = 0;
                 firestoreNotifications = [];
                 virtualAnnouncements = [];
                 return;
             }

            // Inicializar Notificaciones
            const notifWrapper = document.getElementById('notificationWrapper');
            const notifBadge = document.getElementById('notificationBadge');
            const notifBtn = document.getElementById('notificationBellBtn');
            const notifDropdown = document.getElementById('notificationDropdown');
            const notifList = document.getElementById('notificationList');
            
            if (notifWrapper) {
                notifWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
                
                // Toggle Dropdown
                notifBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    notifDropdown.classList.toggle('hidden');
                });
                
                // Cerrar si se clickea afuera
                document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (!notifWrapper.contains(e.target)) {
                        notifDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                });
            }

            // Función centralizada para renderizar la UI de notificaciones
            const refreshNotificationUI = () => {
                try {
                    if (!notifBadge || !notifList) return;

                    const totalUnread = (firestoreUnreadCount || 0) + (virtualAnnouncements ? virtualAnnouncements.length : 0);
                    
                    if (totalUnread > 0) {
                        notifBadge.textContent = totalUnread > 99 ? '99+' : totalUnread;
                        notifBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        notifBadge.classList.add('hidden');
                    }

                    const combinedList = [...(virtualAnnouncements || []), ...(firestoreNotifications || [])];
                    
                    // Ordenar descendente de manera segura
                    combinedList.sort((a, b) => {
                        const timeA = a.createdAt?.toMillis ? a.createdAt.toMillis() : (a.createdAt?.seconds ? a.createdAt.seconds * 1000 : 0);
                        const timeB = b.createdAt?.toMillis ? b.createdAt.toMillis() : (b.createdAt?.seconds ? b.createdAt.seconds * 1000 : 0);
                        return timeB - timeA;
                    });
                    
                    const top5 = combinedList.slice(0, 5);

                    if (top5.length === 0) {
                        notifList.innerHTML = '<div class="notification-empty">No tienes notificaciones recientes.</div>';
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    notifList.innerHTML = top5.map(n => {
                        const isUnread = n.status === 'unread';
                        const titleClass = n.priority === 'urgente' ? 'notification-priority-urgente' : 'notification-title';
                        const urlAttr = n.actionUrl ? `onclick="window.location.href='${n.actionUrl}'" style="cursor:pointer;"` : '';
                        
                        let buttonsHtml = '';
                        if (n.isVirtual) {
                            if (isUnread) buttonsHtml += `<button class="notification-btn" onclick="handleMarkVirtualRead(event, '${n.sourceId}')">Marcar leída</button>`;
                            if (n.actionUrl) buttonsHtml += `<button class="notification-btn" onclick="window.location.href='${n.actionUrl}'">Ver anuncio</button>`;
                        } else {
                            if (isUnread) buttonsHtml += `<button class="notification-btn" onclick="handleMarkRead(event, '${n.id}')">Marcar leída</button>`;
                            buttonsHtml += `<button class="notification-btn" onclick="handleArchive(event, '${n.id}')">Archivar</button>`;
                        }

                        return `
                        <div class="notification-item ${isUnread ? 'unread' : ''}">
                            <div class="notification-item-header" ${urlAttr}>
                                <span class="${titleClass}">${n.priority === 'urgente' ? '⚠️ ' : (n.priority === 'importante' ? '📌 ' : '')}${n.title}</span>
                            </div>
                            <p class="notification-message" ${urlAttr}>${n.message}</p>
                            <div class="notification-actions">
                                ${buttonsHtml}
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    }).join('');
                } catch(e) {
                    console.warn("Error refreshing notification UI:", e);
                }
            };

            // Exponer funciones globales para botones
            window.handleMarkRead = async (e, id) => {
                if(e) e.stopPropagation();
                try { await markNotificationAsRead(user.uid, id); } catch(err) { console.warn(err); }
            };
            window.handleArchive = async (e, id) => {
                if(e) e.stopPropagation();
                try { await archiveNotification(user.uid, id); } catch(err) { console.warn(err); }
            };
            window.handleMarkVirtualRead = async (e, sourceId) => {
                if(e) e.stopPropagation();
                try {
                    await markAsRead(sourceId, user.uid);
                    virtualAnnouncements = virtualAnnouncements.filter(a => a.sourceId !== sourceId);
                    refreshNotificationUI();
                } catch(err) { console.warn("Error marking virtual notification as read:", err); }
            };

            // Suscripciones
            if (unsubscribeUnread) unsubscribeUnread();
            unsubscribeUnread = subscribeToUnreadNotifications(user.uid, (count) => {
                firestoreUnreadCount = count;
                refreshNotificationUI();
            });

            if (unsubscribeRecent) unsubscribeRecent();
            unsubscribeRecent = subscribeToRecentNotifications(user.uid, (notifications) => {
                firestoreNotifications = notifications;
                refreshNotificationUI();
            });

            if (user) {
                // 1. Cargar anuncios
                try {
                    const [announcements, readIds, profile] = await Promise.all([
                        getVisibleAnnouncements(),
                        getUserReadStatus(user.uid),
                        getUserProfile(user.uid)
                    ]);

                    // Fecha de creación del usuario (para no mostrar anuncios previos al registro - Fase 2.0F-11C)
                    const userCreatedAt = profile?.createdAt?.toMillis() || Date.now();

                    // Mapeo a notificaciones virtuales para la campana
                    const virtuals = [];
                    announcements.forEach(a => {
                        const announceTime = a.publishAt?.toMillis() || a.createdAt?.toMillis() || 0;

                        // Solo contar como "pendiente" si:
                        // 1. Es urgente o importante
                        // 2. No ha sido leído
                        // 3. Fue publicado DESPUÉS de que el usuario se uniera
                        if ((a.priority === 'urgente' || a.priority === 'importante') && 
                            !readIds.includes(a.id) &&
                            announceTime >= userCreatedAt) {
                            virtuals.push({
                                id: `virtual_announcement_${a.id}`,
                                type: "announcement",
                                title: a.priority === 'urgente' ? "Anuncio urgente pendiente" : "Anuncio importante pendiente",
                                message: a.title,
                                status: "unread",
                                priority: a.priority,
                                sourceType: "announcement",
                                sourceId: a.id,
                                createdAt: a.publishAt || a.createdAt,
                                actionUrl: "anuncios.html",
                                isVirtual: true
                            });
                        }
                    });
                    
                    if (notifWrapper) {
                        virtualAnnouncements = virtuals;
                        refreshNotificationUI();
                    }
                } catch (e) { 
                    console.warn("Error checking alerts/announcements:", e);
                }

                // 2. Cargar progreso pedagógico real
                try {
                    for (const mod of MODULES_DATA) {
                        const moduleId = `modulo${mod.id}`;
                        const detailed = await getModuleDetailedProgress(user.uid, moduleId);
                        
                        if (!detailed) continue;

                        const percent = detailed.percentComplete;
                        
                        // 1. Actualizar Desglose
                        const breakdownEl = document.getElementById(`breakdown-${mod.id}`);
                        if (breakdownEl) {
                            const b = detailed.breakdown;
                            breakdownEl.innerHTML = `
                                <div class="breakdown-item"><span class="breakdown-label">📖 ${b.contenido.label}</span><span class="breakdown-count">${b.contenido.completed} de ${b.contenido.total}</span></div>
                                <div class="breakdown-item"><span class="breakdown-label">📝 ${b.actividades.label}</span><span class="breakdown-count">${b.actividades.completed} de ${b.actividades.total}</span></div>
                                <div class="breakdown-item"><span class="breakdown-label">💬 ${b.foro.label}</span><span class="breakdown-count">${b.foro.completed} de ${b.foro.total}</span></div>
                                <div class="breakdown-item"><span class="breakdown-label">📚 ${b.recursos.label}</span><span class="breakdown-count">${b.recursos.completed} de ${b.recursos.total}</span></div>
                            `;
                        }

                        // 2. Actualizar Siguiente Paso
                        const nextStepEl = document.getElementById(`next-step-${mod.id}`);
                        const btnAction = document.getElementById(`btn-action-${mod.id}`);
                        
                        if (nextStepEl && btnAction) {
                            if (detailed.nextPage) {
                                nextStepEl.innerHTML = `
                                    <span class="next-step-label">Siguiente paso sugerido</span>
                                    <span class="next-step-title">${detailed.nextPage.title}</span>
                                `;
                                btnAction.href = detailed.nextPage.url;
                                btnAction.textContent = percent > 0 ? 'Continuar' : 'Comenzar';
                                btnAction.classList.replace('btn-secondary', 'btn-primary');
                            } else if (percent === 100) {
                                nextStepEl.innerHTML = `
                                    <span class="next-step-label">Estado del módulo</span>
                                    <span class="next-step-title" style="color: var(--color-brand-secondary);">✅ Módulo completado</span>
                                `;
                                btnAction.textContent = 'Repasar';
                                btnAction.classList.replace('btn-primary', 'btn-secondary');
                            }
                        }

                        // 3. Actualizar Barra y Porcentaje (Secundario)
                        const titleEl = document.getElementById(`module-title-${mod.id}`);
                        if (titleEl) {
                            const card = titleEl.closest('.module-card-refined');
                            const progressText = card.querySelector('.module-stats span:last-child');
                            const progressFill = card.querySelector('.progress-fill');
                            const progressLabel = card.querySelector('.progress');

                            if (progressText) progressText.textContent = `${percent}%`;
                            if (progressFill) progressFill.style.width = `${percent}%`;
                            if (progressLabel) progressLabel.setAttribute('aria-label', `Avance general: ${percent}%`);
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error("Error loading detailed progress:", e);
                }
            }
        });
    </script>
    <div id="institutional-footer"></div>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/institutional-footer.js"></script>
</body>

</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Limpieza de Tablero | Docencia 4.0 Admin</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles/main.css">
    <script type="module" src="scripts/auth-guard.js"></script>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/admin-guard.js"></script>
    <style>
        body { padding: 40px; background: #f8fafc; }
        .admin-tool { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; background: white; padding: 30px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); }
        .warning-box { background: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; padding: 15px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px; }
        .btn-group { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; }
        .btn-download { background: var(--color-brand-primary, #0ea5e9); color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; flex: 1; transition: background 0.2s; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .btn-download:hover { opacity: 0.9; }
        .btn-danger { background: #ef4444; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; flex: 1; transition: background 0.2s; }
        .btn-danger:hover { background: #dc2626; }
        .btn-danger:disabled, .btn-download:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
        #status { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 14px; color: #475569; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="admin-tool">
        <h1>Gestión de Tablero Interactivo</h1>
        <p>Herramienta para administrar los resultados de la <strong>Actividad 1.1</strong>.</p>
        
        <div class="btn-group">
            <button id="download-btn" class="btn-download">📊 Descargar Resultados (CSV)</button>
            <button id="clean-btn" class="btn-danger">🧹 Limpiar Tablero</button>
        </div>

        <div id="status"></div>
        
        <div class="warning-box" style="margin-top: 20px;">
            <strong>⚠️ Atención:</strong> La limpieza eliminará permanentemente todas las reflexiones. Se recomienda descargar los resultados primero.
        </div>
        
        <div style="margin-top: 30px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; pt: 20px;">
            <a href="admin_dashboard.html" style="color: var(--color-brand-primary); text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px;">← Volver al Panel de Administración</a>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script type="module">
        import { auth, db } from './scripts/firebase-config.js';
        import { collection, getDocs, deleteDoc, doc, writeBatch } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js';
        import { onAuthStateChanged } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js';

        const cleanBtn = document.getElementById('clean-btn');
        const downloadBtn = document.getElementById('download-btn');
        const status = document.getElementById('status');

        onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
            if (!user) {
                window.location.href = 'login.html';
                return;
            }
        });

        // Lógica de Descarga CSV
        downloadBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            downloadBtn.disabled = true;
            status.textContent = 'Preparando descarga...';

            try {
                const querySnapshot = await getDocs(collection(db, 'sessions/actividad1_1/responses'));
                
                if (querySnapshot.empty) {
                    status.textContent = 'No hay datos para descargar.';
                    downloadBtn.disabled = false;
                    return;
                }

                let csvContent = "\uFEFF"; // BOM para Excel (UTF-8)
                csvContent += "Fecha,Participante,Reflexión,UID\n";

                querySnapshot.forEach((doc) => {
                    const data = doc.data();
                    const date = data.timestamp ? data.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleString() : 'N/A';
                    const name = `"${(data.displayName || 'Participante').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
                    const text = `"${(data.text || '').replace(/"/g, '""').replace(/\n/g, ' ')}"`;
                    const uid = data.uid || '';
                    
                    csvContent += `${date},${name},${text},${uid}\n`;
                });

                const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
                const link = document.createElement("a");
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.setAttribute("href", url);
                link.setAttribute("download", `resultados_tablero_act1_1_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`);
                link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);

                status.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #16a34a;">✅ Archivo generado con éxito.</span>`;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error al descargar CSV:", error);
                status.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #dc2626;">❌ Error: ${error.message}</span>`;
            } finally {
                downloadBtn.disabled = false;
            }
        });

        // Lógica de Limpieza
        cleanBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            if (!confirm('¿Estás seguro de que deseas borrar TODAS las participaciones? Esta acción es irreversible.')) return;

            cleanBtn.disabled = true;
            status.textContent = 'Iniciando limpieza...';

            try {
                const querySnapshot = await getDocs(collection(db, 'sessions/actividad1_1/responses'));
                const batch = writeBatch(db);
                
                let count = 0;
                querySnapshot.forEach((document) => {
                    batch.delete(doc(db, 'sessions/actividad1_1/responses', document.id));
                    count++;
                });

                if (count > 0) {
                    await batch.commit();
                    status.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #16a34a;">✅ Éxito: Se han eliminado ${count} participaciones.</span>`;
                } else {
                    status.textContent = 'No había participaciones que eliminar.';
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error limpiando el tablero:", error);
                status.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #dc2626;">❌ Error: ${error.message}</span>`;
            } finally {
                cleanBtn.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Debug: Limpiar Foros | Docencia 4.0</title>
    <style>
        body { font-family: sans-serif; padding: 40px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; background: #f4f7f9; }
        .card { background: white; padding: 30px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
        h1 { color: #d32f2f; }
        .warning { background: #fff3e0; border-left: 5px solid #ff9800; padding: 15px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
        button { background: #d32f2f; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; }
        button:disabled { background: #ccc; cursor: not-allowed; }
        #log { margin-top: 20px; background: #263238; color: #afffdf; padding: 15px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; height: 300px; overflow-y: auto; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="card">
        <h1>Herramienta de Limpieza de Foros</h1>
        <div class="warning">
            <strong>⚠️ ATENCIÓN:</strong> Esta acción eliminará <strong>TODAS</strong> las publicaciones y respuestas de todos los foros de la base de datos de Firestore. No se puede deshacer.
        </div>
        <p>Usa esta herramienta para limpiar el entorno de pruebas y validar las restricciones de participación.</p>
        
        <button id="btnClean">🚨 LIMPIAR TODOS LOS FOROS</button>
        <button id="btnResetProgress" style="background: #1a237e; margin-left: 10px;">🔄 RESETEAR MI PROGRESO (Foro M1)</button>
        
        <div id="log">Esperando acción...</div>
    </div>

    <script type="module">
        import { db, auth } from './scripts/firebase-config.js';
        import { collection, getDocs, deleteDoc, doc, query, where } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js';
        import { onAuthStateChanged } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js';

        const logEl = document.getElementById('log');
        const btn = document.getElementById('btnClean');
        const btnReset = document.getElementById('btnResetProgress');

        function log(msg, isError = false) {
            const entry = document.createElement('div');
            entry.style.color = isError ? '#ff8a80' : '#afffdf';
            entry.textContent = `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${msg}`;
            logEl.appendChild(entry);
            logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
        }

        onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
            if (user) {
                log(`Usuario autenticado: ${user.email}`);
                btn.disabled = false;
                btnReset.disabled = false;
            } else {
                log("⚠️ No detecto sesión activa. Por favor, inicia sesión en la plataforma primero.", true);
                btn.disabled = true;
                btnReset.disabled = true;
            }
        });

        btnReset.onclick = async () => {
            const user = auth.currentUser;
            if (!user) return;
            
            btnReset.disabled = true;
            log("Buscando progreso de 'foro_modulo1' para el usuario actual...");
            
            try {
                const progRef = collection(db, "usuarios", user.uid, "progreso_paginas");
                const q = query(progRef, where("pageId", "==", "foro_modulo1"));
                const snap = await getDocs(q);
                
                if (snap.empty) {
                    log("No se encontró registro de progreso para esta página.");
                } else {
                    for (const d of snap.docs) {
                        await deleteDoc(doc(db, "usuarios", user.uid, "progreso_paginas", d.id));
                        log(`[OK] Registro de progreso ${d.id} eliminado.`);
                    }
                }
                log("✅ PROGRESO RESETEADO. Ahora el foro debería aparecer como NO COMPLETADO.");
            } catch (err) {
                log(`❌ Error al resetear progreso: ${err.message}`, true);
            } finally {
                btnReset.disabled = false;
            }
        };

        btn.onclick = async () => {
            if (!confirm("¿Estás seguro de que deseas borrar ABSOLUTAMENTE TODO en los foros?")) return;
            
            btn.disabled = true;
            log("Iniciando limpieza profunda...");
            
            const foros = ["general", "modulo1", "modulo2", "modulo3"];
            
            try {
                for (const foroId of foros) {
                    log(`--- Limpiando foro: ${foroId} ---`);
                    const postsRef = collection(db, "foros", foroId, "publicaciones");
                    const postsSnap = await getDocs(postsRef);
                    
                    log(`Encontradas ${postsSnap.size} publicaciones.`);
                    
                    for (const postDoc of postsSnap.docs) {
                        // 1. Limpiar respuestas de este post
                        const repliesRef = collection(db, "foros", foroId, "publicaciones", postDoc.id, "respuestas");
                        const repliesSnap = await getDocs(repliesRef);
                        if (repliesSnap.size > 0) {
                            log(`  -> Borrando ${repliesSnap.size} respuestas del post ${postDoc.id}...`);
                            for (const replyDoc of repliesSnap.docs) {
                                await deleteDoc(doc(db, "foros", foroId, "publicaciones", postDoc.id, "respuestas", replyDoc.id));
                            }
                        }
                        
                        // 2. Borrar el post
                        await deleteDoc(doc(db, "foros", foroId, "publicaciones", postDoc.id));
                        log(`  [OK] Borrado post: ${postDoc.id}`);
                    }
                }
                
                log("==========================================");
                log("✅ LIMPIEZA COMPLETADA CON ÉXITO.");
                log("Ya puedes recargar la plataforma para validar las restricciones.");
            } catch (error) {
                log(`❌ ERROR CRÍTICO: ${error.message}`, true);
                console.error(error);
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false;
            }
        };
    </script>
</body>
</html>

```
