```html
            background: var(--color-alpha-black-40, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4));
            backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm));
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm));
        }

        .module-sidebar-overlay.active {
            display: block;
        }

        .side-menu-title {
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-md);
            color: var(--color-text-inverse);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
        }

        .menu-links {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
            margin: 0;
        }

        .menu-links li {
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xs);
        }

        .menu-section-label {
            display: block;
            padding: var(--spacing-5) var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-2);
            color: var(--color-cyan-100);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wider);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        .menu-links a {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-3);
            padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            color: var(--color-alpha-white-70);
            font-family: var(--font-family-body);
            font-size: var(--font-size-base);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .menu-links a:hover {
            background: var(--color-alpha-white-15);
            color: var(--color-cyan-100);
        }

        .menu-links a.active {
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
        }

        .content-wrapper {
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: var(--spacing-xl) auto var(--spacing-16);
            padding: 0 var(--spacing-md);
        }

        .lesson-card {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--spacing-16);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
        }

        .page-kicker {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
            color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .page-title {
            display: block;
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-md);
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-tight);
        }

        .page-title span {
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
        }

        .page-intro {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xl);
            font-size: var(--font-size-base);
        }

        .resource-summary-card,
        .resource-guidance-card,
        .resource-section-card,
        .resource-commitment-card,
        .bibliographic-resources__panel,
        .prompt-bank-shell,
        .resource-card,
        .info-card,
        .kit-card {
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
        }

        .resource-summary-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0;
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
        }

        .resource-summary-list {
            margin: var(--spacing-md) 0 var(--spacing-sm);
            padding-left: var(--spacing-6);
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        }

        .resource-summary-list li {
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-2);
        }

        .resource-guidance-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-lg);
            margin: var(--spacing-lg) 0 var(--spacing-12);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-secondary);
        }

        .resource-guidance-card h2,
        .resource-section-card h3,
        .resource-commitment-card h2,
        .kit-card h3 {
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
        }

        .resource-index {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: var(--spacing-sm);
            margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0 var(--spacing-12);
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .resource-index a {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
            min-height: 74px;
            padding: var(--spacing-sm);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
            text-decoration: none;
            text-align: center;
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .resource-index a:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
        }

        .resource-section {
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-16);
            scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--nav-height) + var(--spacing-lg));
        }

        .resource-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
        }

        .resource-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex: 0 0 56px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
        }

        .section-title {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
        }

        .section-helper {
            max-width: 860px;
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-lg);
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        }

        .resource-section-card,
        .resource-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
        }

        .resource-card:hover,
        .info-card:hover,
        .kit-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
        }

        .resource-card,
        .info-card,
        .kit-card {
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .resource-card h3,
        .info-card h3 {
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
        }

        .videos-grid,
        .bibliographic-grid,
        .kit-grid,
        .commitment-grid {
            display: grid;
            gap: var(--spacing-lg);
            margin-top: var(--spacing-xl);
        }

        .videos-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }

        .bibliographic-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .kit-grid,
        .commitment-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }

        .infographics-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 640px);
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-lg);
            margin-top: var(--spacing-xl);
        }

        .info-card,
        .kit-card {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            padding: var(--spacing-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
        }

        .info-card--compact {
            max-width: 640px;
            margin-inline: auto;
        }

        .info-card h3 {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
        }

        .image-zoom-trigger {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            cursor: zoom-in;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
        }

        .info-card--compact .image-zoom-trigger {
            max-width: 440px;
            margin: var(--spacing-md) auto;
        }

        .image-zoom-trigger img {
            width: 100%;
            display: block;
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .image-zoom-trigger:hover img {
            transform: scale(1.02);
        }

        .btn-download,
        .resource-link {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
            margin-top: auto;
            padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            text-align: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .btn-download:hover,
        .resource-link:hover {
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .video-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding-bottom: 56.25%;
            margin: var(--spacing-md) 0;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-card-inverse);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
        }

        .video-wrapper iframe {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border: 0;
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell {
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: var(--spacing-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell__summary {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            align-items: center;
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            cursor: pointer;
            list-style: none;
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
            display: none;
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell__eyebrow {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-1);
            color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell__title {
            display: block;
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell__description {
            display: block;
            margin-top: var(--spacing-2);
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell__meta {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-width: 130px;
            padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-4);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .prompt-bank-shell__action {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
        }

        .prompt-bank {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
        }

        .prompt-bank__toolbar {
            display: grid;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
        }

        .prompt-bank__label {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-2);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
        }

        .prompt-bank__filters {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
        }

        .prompt-bank__filter {
            padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-4);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
            font: inherit;
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .prompt-bank__filter.is-active,
        .prompt-bank__filter:hover {
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
        }

        .prompt-bank__ethics-note {
            padding: var(--spacing-md);
            border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-secondary);
            border-radius: 0 var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg) 0;
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
        }

        .prompt-bank__status {
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
        }

        .prompt-bank__grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
            gap: var(--spacing-lg);
        }

        .prompt-card {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--spacing-sm);
            padding: var(--spacing-lg);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
        }

        .prompt-card__category {
            display: inline-flex;
            width: fit-content;
            padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .prompt-card__title {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
        }

        .prompt-card__description {
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
        }

        .prompt-card__template {
            padding: var(--spacing-md);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
            font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
            white-space: pre-wrap;
        }

        .prompt-bank__copy {
            margin-top: auto;
            padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-brand-secondary);
            color: var(--color-white);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .prompt-bank__copy:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-secondary);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources {
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-16);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__panel {
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__summary {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            align-items: center;
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            cursor: pointer;
            list-style: none;
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
            display: none;
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__summary-icon {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__title {
            display: block;
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__subtitle {
            display: block;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__action {
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__arrow {
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__panel[open] .bibliographic-resources__arrow {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .bibliographic-resources__body {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
        }

        .bibliographic-resource {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
            gap: var(--spacing-lg);
            align-items: start;
            padding: var(--spacing-lg);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
        }

        .bibliographic-resource:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .bibliographic-resource__tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xs);
            padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .bibliographic-resource__title {
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-xs);
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
        }

        .bibliographic-resource__citation {
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
        }

        .bibliographic-resource__details {
            margin-top: var(--spacing-sm);
        }

        .bibliographic-resource__details summary {
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .kit-card {
            min-height: 100%;
        }

        .kit-card__tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            width: fit-content;
            padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .kit-card ol {
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
            padding-left: var(--spacing-6);
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        }

        .kit-card li {
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-2);
        }

        .resource-commitment-card {
            margin: var(--spacing-16) 0 0;
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
        }

        .commitment-item {
            padding: var(--spacing-lg);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
        }

        .final-reflection {
            margin-top: var(--spacing-xl);
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-secondary);
            border-radius: 0 var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0;
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
        }

        .footer-nav {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            margin-top: var(--spacing-16);
            padding-top: var(--spacing-xl);
            border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
        }

        .btn-footer {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
            padding: var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-xl);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .btn-back {
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
        }

        .btn-back:hover {
            transform: translateX(-5px);
        }

        .btn-next {
            background: var(--color-background-button-primary-default, var(--color-brand-secondary));
            color: var(--color-text-button-primary-default, var(--color-white));
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-secondary);
        }

        .btn-next:hover {
            transform: translateX(5px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
        }

        .btn-scroll-top {
            position: fixed;
            right: var(--spacing-lg);
            bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
            z-index: 100;
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
            text-decoration: none;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: opacity var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                visibility var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .btn-scroll-top.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .btn-scroll-top:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        .modal-zoom {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 9999;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: var(--spacing-6);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
        }

        .modal-zoom.is-open {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            position: relative;
            max-width: min(1100px, 95vw);
            max-height: 90vh;
        }

        .modal-content img {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
        }

        .modal-close-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: var(--spacing-3);
            right: var(--spacing-3);
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-alpha-white-90);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        @media (max-width: 1100px) {
            .resource-index {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 960px) {
            .videos-grid,
            .kit-grid,
            .commitment-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .bibliographic-resource {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .content-wrapper {
                padding: 0 var(--spacing-4);
            }

            .lesson-card {
                padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .page-title {
                font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
            }

            .top-nav {
                padding: 0 var(--spacing-4);
            }

            .module-title-nav {
                max-width: 58vw;
                font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            }

            .resource-index,
            .prompt-bank-shell__summary {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .resource-header {
                align-items: flex-start;
            }

            .bibliographic-resources__summary {
                grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
            }

            .bibliographic-resources__action,
            .bibliographic-resources__arrow {
                grid-column: 2;
            }

            .footer-nav {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
                text-align: center;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 520px) {
            :root {
                --module-sidebar-width: 86vw;
            }

            .module-title-nav {
                display: none;
            }

            .lesson-card,
            .resource-card,
            .resource-section-card,
            .resource-summary-card,

            .bibliographic-resource,
            .kit-card,

            .info-card,
            .prompt-bank,
            .resource-commitment-card {
                padding: var(--spacing-md);
                border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <main class="content-wrapper">
        <article class="lesson-card" aria-labelledby="page-title">
            <span class="page-kicker">Módulo 3 · Biblioteca de apoyo</span>
            <h1 id="page-title" class="page-title">Recursos Didácticos Complementarios — <span>Módulo 3</span></h1>
            <p class="page-intro">Materiales complementarios para profundizar en la gestión administrativa y evaluativa impulsada por IA, sin perder el control pedagógico, ético y profesional.</p>

            <section class="resource-summary-card" aria-labelledby="intro-title">
                <h2 id="intro-title" class="section-title">🧭 Introducción a la sección</h2>
                <p>En esta sección encontrarás una <strong>biblioteca curada de recursos complementarios</strong> diseñados para profundizar en la <strong>gestión administrativa y evaluativa impulsada por IA</strong>, consolidando todo lo aprendido en el <strong>Módulo 3</strong>:</p>
                <ul class="resource-summary-list">
                    <li><strong>Diseño automatizado de instrumentos</strong> —Lección 3.1—.</li>
                    <li><strong>Retroalimentación formativa y computación afectiva</strong> —Lección 3.2—.</li>
                    <li><strong>Automatización de la burocracia educativa</strong> —Lección 3.3—.</li>
                    <li><strong>Seguridad de datos</strong> —Lección 3.4—.</li>
                </ul>
                <p>Los materiales están organizados por tipo de recurso —<strong>banco de plantillas administrativas</strong>, <strong>videos de apoyo</strong> e <strong>infografías de protección de datos</strong>— para que puedas elegir el formato que mejor se ajuste a tu necesidad inmediata como <strong>facilitador docente</strong>.</p>
                <p>Cada recurso incluye una breve descripción de cómo te ayuda a profundizar el tema.</p>
            </section>

            <aside class="resource-guidance-card" aria-label="Recordatorio ético de uso de IA">
                <h2>🔒 Recordatorio ético</h2>
                <p>Evita incluir <strong>nombres completos</strong>, <strong>información médica</strong>, <strong>datos estudiantiles sensibles</strong> o <strong>información confidencial</strong> en herramientas de IA.</p>
                <p>Revisa y valida todo documento antes de compartirlo.</p>
            </aside>

            <nav class="resource-index" aria-label="Clasificación de recursos del Módulo 3">
                <a href="#plantillas-title">📂 Plantillas</a>
                <a href="#videos-title">🎥 Videos</a>
                <a href="#infografias-title">🛡️ Infografía</a>
                <a href="#bibliographic-resources-title-m3">📚 Bibliografía</a>
                <a href="#kit-title">🎓 Kit profesional</a>
            </nav>

            <section class="resource-section prompt-bank-section" aria-labelledby="plantillas-title">

                    <div class="resource-icon" aria-hidden="true">📂</div>
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="plantillas-title" class="section-title">1. PROMPTS: Banco de Plantillas Administrativas</h2>
                        <p class="section-helper">Te ofrece <strong>plantillas reutilizables</strong> y listas para adaptar que automatizan la redacción de los documentos administrativos más frecuentes en tu rol como <strong>facilitador docente</strong>. Cada plantilla está categorizada para que encuentres rápido lo que necesitas en el momento exacto.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <details class="prompt-bank-shell" data-prompt-bank-shell-admin>
                    <summary class="prompt-bank-shell__summary">
                        <span>
                            <span class="prompt-bank-shell__eyebrow">Recurso interactivo</span>
                            <span class="prompt-bank-shell__title">Banco de Plantillas Administrativas</span>
                            <span class="prompt-bank-shell__description">Explora plantillas de prompts para generar borradores de cartas, referencias y minutas escolares. Copia la plantilla, adáptala al contexto institucional, anonimiza datos sensibles y valida el resultado antes de compartirlo.</span>
                        </span>
                        <span class="prompt-bank-shell__meta">3 plantillas disponibles</span>
                        <span class="prompt-bank-shell__action">Explorar banco de plantillas</span>
                    </summary>

                    <div class="prompt-bank" data-prompt-bank-admin>
                        <div class="prompt-bank__toolbar" aria-label="Herramientas del banco de plantillas">
                            <div class="prompt-bank__search-wrap">
                                <label for="promptBankAdminSearch" class="prompt-bank__label">Buscar plantilla</label>

                            </div>
                            <div class="prompt-bank__filters" aria-label="Filtrar plantillas por categoría" data-prompt-filters-admin></div>
                            <p class="prompt-bank__ethics-note">🔐 <strong>Recuerda:</strong> antes de usar una plantilla, <strong>adapta el contexto</strong>, <strong>anonimiza los datos sensibles</strong> y <strong>valida el resultado generado por IA</strong> con tu criterio profesional.</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="prompt-bank__status" aria-live="polite" data-prompt-status-admin></div>
                        <div class="prompt-bank__grid" data-prompt-grid-admin></div>

Si eres aprendiz auditivo o visual, los videos consolidan en pocos minutos lo que el texto desarrolla en mayor profundidad.</p>

                                    <p class="bibliographic-resource__citation">Maksimchuk, M., Roeber, E., Store, D., &amp; National Council on Measurement in Education (NCME). (2025). <em>Generative AI in the K–12 Formative Assessment Process: Enhancing feedback in the classroom</em>. In <em>Proceedings of the Artificial Intelligence in Measurement and Education Conference (AIME-Con) – Volume 1: Full Papers</em> (pp. 107–110). https://aclanthology.org/2025.aimecon-main.12.pdf</p>
                                    <details class="bibliographic-resource__details">
                                        <summary>Ver resumen</summary>
                                        <p>El documento explora el potencial de la IA generativa para extender la capacidad docente al proporcionar retroalimentación inmediata y personalizada en entornos escolares de educación básica. (2025). <em>Evaluación formativa e inteligencia artificial: Estrategias para un aprendizaje significativo</em>. <em>MLS Pedagogy, Culture and Innovation Journal</em>, 5(1), 45–62. https://www.mlsjournals.com/Pedagogy-Culture-Innovation/article/view/4153</p>
                                    <details class="bibliographic-resource__details">
                                        <summary>Ver resumen</summary>
                                        <p>Esta investigación analiza cómo la retroalimentación personalizada impulsada por la IA mejora el aprendizaje significativo y la motivación. Destaca la importancia de una visión integradora donde la IA funcione como herramienta complementaria.</p>

            <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="kit-title">
                <div class="resource-header">
                    <div class="resource-icon" aria-hidden="true">🎓</div>
                    <div>

                        <p class="section-helper">En el <strong>Módulo 1</strong> propusimos una ruta de profundización por perfil; en el <strong>Módulo 2</strong>, un maletín profesional de prompts.</p>

    <div id="zoomModal" class="modal-zoom" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="zoom-title" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <h2 id="zoom-title" class="sr-only">Imagen ampliada</h2>
            <button class="modal-close-btn" type="button" onclick="closeZoom()" aria-label="Cerrar imagen ampliada">×</button>
            <img id="zoomedImg" alt="Imagen ampliada del recurso">
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        function resolveAssetPath(img) {
            const assetList = img.dataset.assets;
            const singleAsset = img.dataset.asset;
            const candidates = assetList
                ? assetList.split('|').flatMap((fileName) => [`assets/${fileName}`, `./assets/${fileName}`, `/assets/${fileName}`])
                : singleAsset
                    ? [`assets/${singleAsset}`, `./assets/${singleAsset}`, `/assets/${singleAsset}`]
                    : [];

            if (!candidates.length) return;

            let index = 0;
            img.onerror = () => {
                if (index < candidates.length) {
                    img.src = candidates[index];
                    index += 1;
                } else {
                    img.onerror = null;
                    console.warn(`No se pudo cargar la imagen: ${singleAsset || assetList}`);
                }
            };

            img.src = candidates[index];
            index += 1;
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('img[data-asset], img[data-assets]').forEach(resolveAssetPath);

        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
        const menuButton = document.querySelector('.menu-btn');
        const zoomModal = document.getElementById('zoomModal');
        const zoomedImg = document.getElementById('zoomedImg');
        const scrollTopBtn = document.getElementById('scrollTopBtn');
        let lastFocusedElement = null;

        function openSidebar() {
            if (!sidebar || !overlay || !menuButton) return;
            sidebar.classList.add('active');
            overlay.classList.add('active');
            sidebar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Cerrar menú de navegación');
        }

        function closeSidebar() {
            if (!sidebar || !overlay || !menuButton) return;
            sidebar.classList.remove('active');
            overlay.classList.remove('active');
            sidebar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Abrir menú de navegación');
        }

        function toggleSidebar() {
            if (!sidebar) return;
            sidebar.classList.contains('active') ? closeSidebar() : openSidebar();
        }

        function openZoom(src) {
            if (!zoomModal || !zoomedImg) return;
            lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
            zoomedImg.src = src;
            zoomModal.classList.add('is-open');
            zoomModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

            const closeButton = zoomModal.querySelector('.modal-close-btn');
            if (closeButton) closeButton.focus();
        }

        function closeZoom() {
            if (!zoomModal || !zoomedImg) return;
            zoomModal.classList.remove('is-open');
            zoomModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            zoomedImg.removeAttribute('src');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';

            if (lastFocusedElement && typeof lastFocusedElement.focus === 'function') {
                lastFocusedElement.focus();
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                if (zoomModal && zoomModal.classList.contains('is-open')) closeZoom();
                if (sidebar && sidebar.classList.contains('active')) {
                    closeSidebar();
                    menuButton?.focus();
                }
            }
        });

        zoomModal?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            if (event.target === zoomModal) closeZoom();
        });

        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (!scrollTopBtn) return;
            scrollTopBtn.classList.toggle('visible', window.pageYOffset > 300);
        });

        scrollTopBtn?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });

        const adminTemplateItems = [
            {
                category: 'Comunicación Institucional',
                title: 'Comunicación con Padres',
                description: 'Redacta cartas formales pero cálidas para fortalecer el vínculo escuela-familia con empatía y profesionalismo.',
                template: 'Actúa como facilitador docente del DEPR. Redacta una comunicación formal dirigida a padres o encargados sobre [PROPÓSITO]. Contexto: [grado o grupo], [fecha], [acción requerida], [fecha límite] y [contacto institucional]. Usa tono respetuoso, claro y cercano para Puerto Rico. No incluyas datos personales identificables. Entrega un borrador editable en formato Markdown con campos entre corchetes para personalización docente.'
            },
            {
                category: 'Recomendación Académica',
                title: 'Referencia Académica',
                description: 'Genera cartas de recomendación académica profesionales y persuasivas para postulaciones estudiantiles.',
                template: 'Actúa como facilitador docente del DEPR. Redacta una referencia académica profesional para [PROPÓSITO DE LA POSTULACIÓN]. Usa evidencia observable sobre [fortalezas académicas], [responsabilidad], [participación] y [logros]. Mantén tono formal, preciso y ético. No inventes información ni incluyas datos sensibles. Usa campos editables entre corchetes para nombres, fechas e institución destinataria.'
            },
            {
                category: 'Documentación Administrativa',
                title: 'Generador de Minutas Escolares',
                description: 'Transforma apuntes informales o transcripciones en minutas profesionales listas para archivo institucional.',
                template: 'Actúa como secretario de comité escolar del DEPR. Transforma las siguientes notas en una minuta profesional: [PEGAR NOTAS ANONIMIZADAS]. Organiza el documento con: fecha, propósito de la reunión, asistentes por rol, temas discutidos, acuerdos, responsables, fechas de seguimiento y próximos pasos. Mantén tono administrativo, objetivo y conciso. No incluyas información personal identificable; usa roles o códigos generales cuando sea necesario.'
            }
        ];

        const adminPromptGrid = document.querySelector('[data-prompt-grid-admin]');
        const adminPromptFilters = document.querySelector('[data-prompt-filters-admin]');
        const adminPromptSearch = document.querySelector('[data-prompt-search-admin]');
        const adminPromptStatus = document.querySelector('[data-prompt-status-admin]');
        let currentAdminPromptFilter = 'Todas';

        function getAdminPromptCategories() {
            return ['Todas', ...Array.from(new Set(adminTemplateItems.map((item) => item.category)))];
        }

        function renderAdminPromptFilters() {
            if (!adminPromptFilters) return;
            adminPromptFilters.innerHTML = getAdminPromptCategories().map((category) => `
                <button type="button" class="prompt-bank__filter${category === currentAdminPromptFilter ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-admin-filter="${category}">
                    ${category}
                </button>
            `).join('');

            adminPromptFilters.querySelectorAll('[data-admin-filter]').forEach((button) => {
                button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    currentAdminPromptFilter = button.dataset.adminFilter;
                    renderAdminPromptFilters();
                    renderAdminPrompts();
                });
            });
        }

        function adminPromptMatches(item, query) {
            const haystack = `${item.category} ${item.title} ${item.description} ${item.template}`.toLowerCase();
            return haystack.includes(query.toLowerCase());
        }

        function renderAdminPrompts() {
            if (!adminPromptGrid || !adminPromptStatus) return;
            const query = adminPromptSearch ? adminPromptSearch.value.trim() : '';
            const filtered = adminTemplateItems.filter((item) => {
                const filterOk = currentAdminPromptFilter === 'Todas' || item.category === currentAdminPromptFilter;
                const searchOk = !query || adminPromptMatches(item, query);
                return filterOk && searchOk;
            });

            adminPromptStatus.textContent = `${filtered.length} plantilla${filtered.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} mostrada${filtered.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`;

            adminPromptGrid.innerHTML = filtered.map((item) => `
                <article class="prompt-card">
                    <span class="prompt-card__category">${item.category}</span>
                    <h3 class="prompt-card__title">${item.title}</h3>
                    <p class="prompt-card__description">${item.description}</p>
                    <div class="prompt-card__template">${item.template}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="prompt-bank__copy" data-copy-admin-index="${adminTemplateItems.indexOf(item)}">Copiar plantilla</button>
                </article>
            `).join('');

            adminPromptGrid.querySelectorAll('[data-copy-admin-index]').forEach((button) => {
                button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                    const item = adminTemplateItems[Number(button.dataset.copyAdminIndex)];
                    if (!item) return;
                    const text = item.template;
                    try {
                        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
                        button.textContent = 'Plantilla copiada';
                        window.setTimeout(() => button.textContent = 'Copiar plantilla', 1800);
                    } catch {
                        const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
                        textarea.value = text;
                        document.body.appendChild(textarea);
                        textarea.select();
                        document.execCommand('copy');
                        document.body.removeChild(textarea);
                        button.textContent = 'Plantilla copiada';
                        window.setTimeout(() => button.textContent = 'Copiar plantilla', 1800);
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        adminPromptSearch?.addEventListener('input', renderAdminPrompts);

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            renderAdminPromptFilters();
            renderAdminPrompts();
        });
    </script>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/progress-tracker.js"></script>
    <div id="institutional-footer"></div>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/institutional-footer.js"></script>
</body>

</html>
```

```html
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex: 0 0 56px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
        }

        .section-title {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
        }

        .resource-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .resource-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
        }

        .resource-card h3,
        .info-card h3 {
            margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-md);
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
            line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
        }

        .resource-instruction {
            margin-top: var(--spacing-lg);
            color: var(--color-text-display);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
        }

        .genially-frame-wrap,
        .video-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-card-inverse, #000);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
        }

        .genially-frame-inner,
        .video-frame-inner {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 0;
            padding-bottom: 56.25%;
        }

        .genially-frame-inner iframe,
        .video-frame-inner iframe {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border: 0;
        }

        .videos-grid,
        .infographics-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: var(--spacing-lg);
            margin-top: var(--spacing-xl);
        }

        .youtube-link,
        .resource-link {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
            margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .youtube-link:hover,
        .resource-link:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        .info-card {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .info-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
        }

        .image-zoom-trigger,
        .info-img-container {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0;
            margin: var(--spacing-md) 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            cursor: zoom-in;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
        }

        .image-zoom-trigger img,
        .info-img-container img {
            width: 100%;
            display: block;
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .image-zoom-trigger:hover img,
        .info-img-container:hover img {
            transform: scale(1.02);
        }

        .info-description {
            margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
        }

        .btn-resource,
        .btn-biblio {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
            padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            text-align: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .btn-resource:hover,
        .btn-biblio:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            text-decoration: none;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
        }

        .btn-resource.is-primary,
        .btn-biblio-pdf {
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
            border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
        }

        .btn-biblio-web {
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary);
            border-color: var(--color-border-default);
        }

        .biblio-item {
            padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            background: var(--color-background-surface);
            border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }
        .footer-nav {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-md);
            margin-top: var(--spacing-16);
            padding-top: var(--spacing-xl);
            border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
        }

        .btn-footer {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--spacing-2);
            padding: var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-xl);
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .btn-back {
            background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
        }

        .btn-back:hover {
            transform: translateX(-5px);
        }

        .btn-next {
            background: var(--color-background-button-primary-default, var(--color-brand-secondary));
            color: var(--color-text-button-primary-default, var(--color-white));
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-secondary);
        }

        .btn-next:hover {
            transform: translateX(5px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
        }

        .btn-scroll-top {
            position: fixed;
            right: var(--spacing-lg);
            bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
            z-index: 100;
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-brand-primary);
            color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
            text-decoration: none;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: opacity var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                visibility var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
                transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
        }

        .btn-scroll-top.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .btn-scroll-top:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /* MODAL */
        .modal-zoom {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 9999;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: var(--spacing-6);
            background: var(--color-alpha-black-90, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9));
        }

        .modal-zoom.is-open {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            position: relative;
            max-width: min(1100px, 95vw);
            max-height: 90vh;
        }

        .modal-content img {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
        }

        .modal-close-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: var(--spacing-3);
            right: var(--spacing-3);
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
            background: var(--color-alpha-white-90);
            color: var(--color-text-primary);
            font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .content-wrapper {
                padding: 0 var(--spacing-4);
            }

            .lesson-card,
            .resource-card,
            .info-card,
            .biblio-item {
                padding: var(--spacing-xl);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .page-title {
                font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
            }

            .top-nav {
                padding: 0 var(--spacing-4);
            }

            .module-title-nav {
                max-width: 58vw;
                font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            }

            .resource-header {
                align-items: flex-start;
            }

            .footer-nav {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
                text-align: center;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 520px) {
            :root {
                --module-sidebar-width: 86vw;
            }

            .module-title-nav {
                display: none;
            }

            .lesson-card,
            .resource-card,
            .info-card,
            .biblio-item {
                padding: var(--spacing-md);
                border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

                                <p class="bibliographic-resource__citation">Maksimchuk, M., Roeber, E., Store, D., &amp; National Council on Measurement in Education (NCME). (2025). <em>Generative AI in the K–12 Formative Assessment Process: Enhancing feedback in the classroom</em>. In Proceedings of the Artificial Intelligence in Measurement and Education Conference (AIME-Con) – Volume 1: Full Papers (pp. 107–110). https://aclanthology.org/2025.aimecon-main.12.pdf</p>

MLS Pedagogy, Culture and Innovation Journal, 5(1), 45-62. https://www.mlsjournals.com/Pedagogy-Culture-Innovation/article/view/4153</p>

    <div id="zoomModal" class="modal-zoom" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="zoom-title"
        aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <h2 id="zoom-title" class="sr-only">Imagen ampliada del recurso</h2>
            <button class="modal-close-btn" type="button" onclick="closeZoom()"
                aria-label="Cerrar imagen ampliada">×</button>
            <img id="zoomedImg" alt="Imagen ampliada del recurso">
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        function resolveAssetPath(img) {
            const rawAssets = img.dataset.assets || img.dataset.asset;
            if (!rawAssets) return;

            const fileNames = rawAssets
                .split('|')
                .map((item) => item.trim())
                .filter(Boolean);

            const paths = [];
            const bases = ['./assets/', 'assets/', 'assets/', '../assets/', '../../assets/', '/assets/'];

            fileNames.forEach((fileName) => {
                const encodedFileName = fileName
                    .split('/')
                    .map((part) => encodeURIComponent(part))
                    .join('/');

                bases.forEach((base) => {
                    paths.push(`${base}${fileName}`);
                    paths.push(`${base}${encodedFileName}`);
                });
            });

            const uniqueCandidates = [...new Set(paths)];
            let index = 0;

            img.onerror = () => {
                if (index < uniqueCandidates.length) {
                    img.src = uniqueCandidates[index];
                    index += 1;
                } else {
                    img.onerror = null;
                    console.warn(`No se pudo cargar la imagen. Verifica que exista en assets y que el nombre coincida exactamente con alguno de estos: ${fileNames.join(', ')}`);
                }
            };

            if (uniqueCandidates.length > 0) {
                img.src = uniqueCandidates[index];
                index += 1;
            }
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('img[data-assets], img[data-asset]').forEach(resolveAssetPath);

        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
        const menuButton = document.querySelector('.menu-btn');
        const zoomModal = document.getElementById('zoomModal');
        const zoomedImg = document.getElementById('zoomedImg');
        const scrollTopBtn = document.getElementById('scrollTopBtn');
        let lastFocusedElement = null;

        function openSidebar() {
            if (!sidebar || !overlay || !menuButton) return;
            sidebar.classList.add('active');
            overlay.classList.add('active');
            sidebar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Cerrar menú de navegación');
        }

        function closeSidebar() {
            if (!sidebar || !overlay || !menuButton) return;
            sidebar.classList.remove('active');
            overlay.classList.remove('active');
            sidebar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            menuButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Abrir menú de navegación');
        }

        function toggleSidebar() {
            if (!sidebar) return;
            sidebar.classList.contains('active') ? closeSidebar() : openSidebar();
        }

        function openZoom(src) {
            if (!zoomModal || !zoomedImg) return;
            lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
            zoomedImg.src = src;
            zoomModal.classList.add('is-open');
            zoomModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            const closeButton = zoomModal.querySelector('.modal-close-btn');
            if (closeButton) closeButton.focus();
        }

        function closeZoom() {
            if (!zoomModal || !zoomedImg) return;
            zoomModal.classList.remove('is-open');
            zoomModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            zoomedImg.removeAttribute('src');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';

            if (lastFocusedElement && typeof lastFocusedElement.focus === 'function') {
                lastFocusedElement.focus();
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                if (zoomModal && zoomModal.classList.contains('is-open')) closeZoom();
                if (sidebar && sidebar.classList.contains('active')) {
                    closeSidebar();
                    menuButton?.focus();
                }
            }
        });

        zoomModal?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            if (event.target === zoomModal) closeZoom();
        });

        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (!scrollTopBtn) return;
            scrollTopBtn.classList.toggle('visible', window.pageYOffset > 300);
        });

        scrollTopBtn?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
    </script>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/progress-tracker.js"></script>
    <div id="institutional-footer"></div>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/institutional-footer.js"></script>
    <script src="scripts/prompt-bank-admin.js" defer></script>
</body>

</html>
```

```html
                    ¿Ya tienes una cuenta? <a href="index.html">Inicia sesión</a>

    <script>
        function resolveAssetPath(img) {
            const rawAssets = img.dataset.assets || img.dataset.asset;
            if (!rawAssets) return;

            const fileNames = rawAssets
                .split('|')
                .map((item) => item.trim())
                .filter(Boolean);

            const paths = [];
            const bases = ['./assets/', 'assets/', 'assets/', '../../assets/', '../../../assets/', '/assets/'];

            fileNames.forEach((fileName) => {
                const encodedFileName = fileName
                    .split('/')
                    .map((part) => encodeURIComponent(part))
                    .join('/');

                bases.forEach((base) => {
                    paths.push(`${base}${fileName}`);
                    paths.push(`${base}${encodedFileName}`);
                });
            });

            const uniqueCandidates = [...new Set(paths)];
            let index = 0;

            img.onerror = () => {
                if (index < uniqueCandidates.length) {
                    img.src = uniqueCandidates[index];
                    index += 1;
                } else {
                    img.onerror = null;
                    console.warn(`No se pudo cargar la imagen. Verifica que exista en assets y que el nombre coincida exactamente con alguno de estos: ${fileNames.join(', ')}`);
                }
            };

            if (uniqueCandidates.length > 0) {
                img.src = uniqueCandidates[index];
                index += 1;
            }
        }

        function togglePasswordVisibility(inputId, toggleButton) {
            const passwordInput = document.getElementById(inputId);

            if (!passwordInput || !toggleButton) return;

            const isPasswordVisible = passwordInput.type === 'text';
            passwordInput.type = isPasswordVisible ? 'password' : 'text';
            toggleButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!isPasswordVisible));
            toggleButton.setAttribute('aria-label', isPasswordVisible ? 'Mostrar contraseña' : 'Ocultar contraseña');
        }

        function showAuthMessage(message, type = 'info') {
            const authMessage = document.getElementById('authMessage');
            if (!authMessage) return;

            authMessage.textContent = message;
            authMessage.className = `auth-message is-visible is-${type}`;
        }

        function evaluatePasswordStrength(password) {
            let score = 0;

            if (password.length >= 8) score += 25;
            if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) score += 25;
            if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) score += 25;
            if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) score += 25;

            return score;
        }

        function updatePasswordStrength() {
            const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
            const strengthFill = document.getElementById('strengthFill');
            const strengthLabel = document.getElementById('strengthLabel');

            if (!passwordInput || !strengthFill || !strengthLabel) return;

            const score = evaluatePasswordStrength(passwordInput.value);
            strengthFill.style.width = `${score}%`;

            if (!passwordInput.value) {
                strengthLabel.textContent = 'Fortaleza: sin evaluar';
            } else if (score < 50) {
                strengthLabel.textContent = 'Fortaleza: baja';
            } else if (score < 75) {
                strengthLabel.textContent = 'Fortaleza: media';
            } else {
                strengthLabel.textContent = 'Fortaleza: adecuada';
            }
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('img[data-assets], img[data-asset]').forEach(resolveAssetPath);

        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
        const registerForm = document.getElementById('registerForm');

        passwordInput?.addEventListener('input', updatePasswordStrength);

        registerForm?.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();

            const emailInput = document.getElementById('email');
            const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
            const confirmPasswordInput = document.getElementById('confirmPassword');
            const acceptTerms = document.getElementById('acceptTerms');

            const email = emailInput?.value.trim();
            const password = passwordInput?.value.trim();
            const confirmPassword = confirmPasswordInput?.value.trim();

            if (!email || !password || !confirmPassword) {
                showAuthMessage('Completa el email, la contraseña y la confirmación de contraseña.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            if (password.length < 8) {
                showAuthMessage('La contraseña debe tener al menos 8 caracteres.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            if (password !== confirmPassword) {
                showAuthMessage('Las contraseñas no coinciden. Verifica ambos campos.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            if (!acceptTerms?.checked) {
                showAuthMessage('Debes aceptar el uso responsable de la plataforma para continuar.', 'error');
                return;
            }
        });
    </script>

    <!-- Firebase Auth Integration -->
    <script type="module" src="scripts/public-auth-check.js?v=2.0F13f"></script>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/register-handler.js?v=2.0F13f"></script>
    <div id="institutional-footer"></div>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/institutional-footer.js"></script>
</body>

</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Trivia IA: El Cerebro Digital</title>
    <script type="module" src="scripts/auth-guard.js"></script>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #6366f1;
            --secondary: #a855f7;
            --accent: #22d3ee;
            --bg: #0f172a;
            --card-bg: #1e293b;
            --text: #f8fafc;
            --success: #22c55e;
            --error: #ef4444;
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .container {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 600px;
            perspective: 1000px;
        }

        .card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 30px;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: conic-gradient(transparent, var(--primary), transparent 30%);
            animation: rotate 10s linear infinite;
            z-index: -1;
            opacity: 0.1;
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
            from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        #intro-screen, #quiz-screen, #result-screen {
            display: none;
            animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
        }

        #intro-screen.active, #quiz-screen.active, #result-screen.active {
            display: block;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            text-align: center;
        }

        p {
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            color: #cbd5e1;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 15px 30px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            width: 100%;
            transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
        }

        .btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
        }

        .btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.98);
        }

        .progress-container {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;
            background: #334155;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        #progress-bar {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--accent);

            border-radius: 4px;

        }

        .question-text {
            font-size: 1.2rem;

        .options {

            gap: 12px;
```
