        }

        .option:hover {
            background: #475569;
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .option.correct {
            background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2);
            border-color: var(--success);
        }

        .option.wrong {
            background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
            border-color: var(--error);
        }

        .score-display {
            font-size: 3rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            background: var(--primary);

        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .card { padding: 20px; }
            h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; }
            .question-text { font-size: 1.1rem; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="container">
    <div class="card">
        <!-- Pantalla de Inicio -->
        <div id="intro-screen" class="active">
            <div style="text-align: center; font-size: 3rem;">🤖</div>
            <h1>Trivia IA: Lección 1.1</h1>
            <p>Pon a prueba tus conocimientos sobre Modelos de Lenguaje de Gran Tamaño (LLM), su evolución y su aplicación en la educación.</p>
            <button class="btn" onclick="startQuiz()">Comenzar Desafío</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Pantalla de Quiz -->
        <div id="quiz-screen">
            <div class="progress-container">
                <div id="progress-bar"></div>
            </div>
            <div id="question-counter" class="badge">Pregunta 1 de 8</div>
            <div class="question-text" id="question-content"></div>
            <div class="options" id="options-container"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Pantalla de Resultados -->
        <div id="result-screen">
            <h1>¡Misión Cumplida!</h1>
            <div class="score-display" id="final-score">0%</div>
            <p id="result-message"></p>
            <button class="btn" onclick="resetQuiz()">Reintentar</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    const questions = [
        {
            q: "¿Cuál es la función principal de un LLM durante su entrenamiento?",
            o: ["Localizar fuentes en la web", "Predecir la siguiente palabra más probable", "Clasificar correos institucionales", "Corregir gramática en tiempo real"],
            a: 1
        },
        {
            q: "¿Qué arquitectura permite a los LLM capturar significado y contexto en textos extensos?",
            o: ["Deep Learning clásico", "Redes Neuronales de Reglas", "Arquitectura Transformer", "Sistema de n-gramas"],
            a: 2
        },
        {
            q: "¿Por qué los LLM a veces 'alucinan'?",
            o: ["Por fallos en el servidor", "Por falta de memoria RAM", "Por su lógica de predicción probabilística ante datos ambiguos", "Porque están programados para mentir"],
            a: 2
        },
        {
            q: "En el funcionamiento interno, ¿cómo se llaman las unidades mínimas en que se descompone la entrada?",
            o: ["Bits", "Nodos", "Tokens", "Sintaxis"],
            a: 2
        },
        {
            q: "¿En qué etapa de la evolución se encuentran modelos como ELIZA?",
            o: ["Modelos Estadísticos", "Modelos Basados en Reglas", "Era de los Transformers", "Modelos de Lenguaje Neuronales"],
            a: 1
        },
        {
            q: "Si un docente necesita 'información comprobable y citada', ¿qué herramienta debe usar primero?",
            o: ["Un LLM puro", "ChatGPT", "Un buscador tradicional", "Un bot educativo"],
            a: 2
        },
        {
            q: "¿Qué técnica guía al modelo a producir pasos de razonamiento intermedio antes de dar una respuesta?",
            o: ["Tokenización", "Chain of Thought (CoT)", "Andamiaje (Scaffolding)", "Prompting Directo"],
            a: 1
        },
        {
            q: "¿Cuál es la principal diferencia práctica entre ChatGPT y Microsoft Copilot para un docente?",
            o: ["ChatGPT es de pago y Copilot es gratis", "Copilot se integra en el flujo de trabajo institucional (Word, PPT)", "ChatGPT no permite generar imágenes", "Copilot no usa modelos GPT"],
            a: 1
        }
    ];

    let currentQuestion = 0;
    let score = 0;
    let acceptingAnswers = true;

    function startQuiz() {
        document.getElementById('intro-screen').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('quiz-screen').classList.add('active');
        showQuestion();
    }

    function showQuestion() {
        acceptingAnswers = true;
        const q = questions[currentQuestion];
        document.getElementById('question-content').innerText = q.q;
        document.getElementById('question-counter').innerText = `Pregunta ${currentQuestion + 1} de ${questions.length}`;
        
        const optionsContainer = document.getElementById('options-container');
        optionsContainer.innerHTML = '';
        
        q.o.forEach((option, index) => {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.classList.add('option');
            div.innerText = option;
            div.onclick = () => selectOption(index, div);
            optionsContainer.appendChild(div);
        });

        const progress = ((currentQuestion) / questions.length) * 100;
        document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width = `${progress}%`;
    }

    function selectOption(index, element) {
        if (!acceptingAnswers) return;
        acceptingAnswers = false;

        const correct = questions[currentQuestion].a;
        if (index === correct) {
            score++;
            element.classList.add('correct');
        } else {
            element.classList.add('wrong');
            document.querySelectorAll('.option')[correct].classList.add('correct');
        }

        setTimeout(() => {
            currentQuestion++;
            if (currentQuestion < questions.length) {
                showQuestion();
            } else {
                showResults();
            }
        }, 1500);
    }

    function showResults() {
        document.getElementById('quiz-screen').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('result-screen').classList.add('active');
        
        const finalScorePercent = Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100);
        document.getElementById('final-score').innerText = `${finalScorePercent}%`;
        
        let message = "";
        if (finalScorePercent === 100) message = "¡Excelente! Eres un experto en LLM y panorama tecnológico.";
        else if (finalScorePercent >= 70) message = "¡Muy bien! Tienes bases sólidas sobre el funcionamiento de la IA.";
        else message = "Buen intento. Te recomendamos repasar los conceptos de tokens y la evolución de los modelos.";
        
        document.getElementById('result-message').innerText = message;
        document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width = `100%`;
    }

    function resetQuiz() {
        currentQuestion = 0;
        score = 0;
        document.getElementById('result-screen').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('intro-screen').classList.add('active');
    }
</script>

</body>
</html>

/* ========================================================================== 
   DESIGN TOKENS — DOCENCIA 4.0
   Sistema de tres capas: Global (Core) -> Semantic (Alias) -> Component (Mapped)
   Convención: --[categoria]-[tipo]-[componente]-[variante]-[estado]

   Ajustado según pantallas de referencia del producto:
   - Login, Dashboard, Actividades, Recursos, Comunicados, Admin, Checkpoint
   - Color primario de marca: cyan #00C2FF

   ========================================================================== */

:root {

   /* =======================================================================
      CAPA 1 — GLOBAL / CORE TOKENS
      Valores puros sin rol asignado. Nomenclatura por escala numérica.
      ======================================================================= */

   /* ===== COLOR — CYAN / MARCA PRIMARIA ===== */
   --color-cyan-50: #E0F7FF;

   --color-teal-500: #006688;
   --color-teal-600: #006F8A;
   --color-teal-700: #004C66;
   --color-teal-900: #001E2B;

   /* ===== COLOR — ORANGE / CTA ===== */
   --color-orange-50: #FFF1EB;
   --color-orange-100: #FFDECD;
   --color-orange-200: #FFB99A;
   --color-orange-300: #FF9466;
   --color-orange-400: #FF7840;
   --color-orange-500: #FF8D5C;
   --color-orange-600: #E67E52;
   --color-orange-700: #B36240;
   --color-orange-800: #9D4318;
   --color-orange-900: #722700;

   /* ===== COLOR — INDIGO / TERCIARIO ===== */
   --color-indigo-100: #E5E9F5;
   --color-indigo-300: #A4B5D9;
   --color-indigo-600: #4E5F7E;

   /* ===== COLOR — GREEN / ÉXITO ===== */
   --color-green-100: #DCFCE7;
   --color-green-500: #22C55E;
   --color-green-700: #15803D;

   /* ===== COLOR — FEEDBACK COMPLEMENTARIO ===== */
   --color-yellow-100: #FEF3C7;
   --color-yellow-500: #F59E0B;
   --color-yellow-800: #92400E;
   --color-red-100: #FEE2E2;
   --color-red-600: #DC2626;
   --color-red-800: #991B1B;

   /* ===== COLOR — SLATE / NEUTRALES ===== */
   --color-slate-50: #F8FAFC;
   --color-slate-75: #F6FAFE;
   --color-slate-100: #F1F5F9;
   --color-slate-150: #F0F4F8;
   --color-slate-200: #EAEEF2;
   --color-slate-250: #E4E9ED;
   --color-slate-300: #DFE3E7;
   --color-slate-350: #CBD5E1;
   --color-slate-400: #BCC8D1;
   --color-slate-500: #94A3B8;
   --color-slate-600: #6D7980;
   --color-slate-700: #475569;
   --color-slate-750: #3D484F;
   --color-slate-800: #334155;
   --color-slate-850: #171C1F;
   --color-slate-900: #0F172A;
   --color-slate-950: #020617;

   /* ===== COLOR — NEUTRAL ===== */
   --color-white: #FFFFFF;
   --color-black: #000000;

   /* ===== COLOR — ALPHA ===== */
   --color-alpha-white-90: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.90);
   --color-alpha-white-80: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.80);
   --color-alpha-white-70: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.70);
   --color-alpha-white-50: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.50);
   --color-alpha-white-30: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30);
   --color-alpha-white-15: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
   --color-alpha-cyan-30: rgba(0, 194, 255, 0.30);
   --color-alpha-cyan-15: rgba(0, 194, 255, 0.15);
   --color-alpha-orange-30: rgba(255, 141, 92, 0.30);
   --color-alpha-orange-15: rgba(255, 141, 92, 0.15);
   --color-alpha-teal-06: rgba(0, 102, 136, 0.06);
   --color-alpha-teal-12: rgba(0, 76, 102, 0.12);
   --color-alpha-black-03: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
   --color-alpha-black-05: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
   --color-alpha-black-10: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10);
   --color-alpha-black-15: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);

   /* ===== SPACING — BASE 4PX ===== */
   --spacing-0: 0px;
   --spacing-1: 4px;
   --spacing-2: 8px;
   --spacing-3: 12px;
   --spacing-4: 16px;
   --spacing-5: 20px;
   --spacing-6: 24px;
   --spacing-7: 28px;
   --spacing-8: 32px;
   --spacing-10: 40px;
   --spacing-12: 48px;
   --spacing-14: 56px;
   --spacing-16: 64px;
   --spacing-20: 80px;
   --spacing-24: 96px;

   /* ===== SIZE ===== */
   --size-container-max: 1400px;
   --size-auth-shell-max: 1280px;
   --size-sidebar-width: 280px;
   --size-sidebar-rail: 72px;
   --size-topbar-height: 72px;
   --size-progress-height: 8px;
   --size-progress-height-lg: 12px;
   --size-avatar-xs: 24px;
   --size-avatar-sm: 32px;
   --size-avatar-md: 40px;
   --size-avatar-lg: 56px;
   --size-icon-xs: 16px;
   --size-icon-sm: 20px;
   --size-icon-md: 24px;
   --size-icon-lg: 32px;
   --size-icon-container-sm: 40px;
   --size-icon-container: 48px;
   --size-icon-container-lg: 56px;

   /* ===== BORDER RADIUS ===== */
   --border-radius-none: 0px;
   --border-radius-sm: 4px;
   --border-radius-md: 8px;
   --border-radius-lg: 12px;
   --border-radius-xl: 16px;
   --border-radius-2xl: 20px;
   --border-radius-3xl: 24px;
   --border-radius-4xl: 32px;
   --border-radius-5xl: 48px;
   --border-radius-full: 9999px;

   /* ===== BORDER WIDTH ===== */
   --border-width-0: 0px;
   --border-width-1: 1px;
   --border-width-2: 2px;
   --border-width-3: 3px;
   --border-width-4: 4px;
   --border-width-6: 6px;

   /* ===== FONT FAMILY ===== */
   --font-family-heading: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
   --font-family-body: 'Manrope', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
   --font-family-label: 'Manrope', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;

   /* ===== FONT SIZE ===== */
   --font-size-2xs: 0.6875rem;
   --font-size-xs: 0.75rem;
   --font-size-sm: 0.875rem;
   --font-size-base: 1rem;
   --font-size-lg: 1.125rem;
   --font-size-xl: 1.25rem;
   --font-size-2xl: 1.5rem;
   --font-size-3xl: 1.875rem;
   --font-size-4xl: 2.25rem;
   --font-size-5xl: 3rem;
   --font-size-6xl: 3.75rem;

   /* ===== FONT WEIGHT ===== */
   --font-weight-regular: 400;
   --font-weight-medium: 500;
   --font-weight-semibold: 600;
   --font-weight-bold: 700;
   --font-weight-extrabold: 800;
   --font-weight-black: 900;

   /* ===== LINE HEIGHT ===== */
   --line-height-none: 1;
   --line-height-tight: 1.15;
   --line-height-snug: 1.3;
   --line-height-relaxed: 1.5;
   --line-height-normal: 1.6;
   --line-height-loose: 1.75;

   /* ===== LETTER SPACING ===== */
   --letter-spacing-tight: -0.02em;
   --letter-spacing-normal: 0;
   --letter-spacing-wide: 0.05em;
   --letter-spacing-wider: 0.1em;

   /* ===== SHADOW ===== */
   --shadow-none: none;
   --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
   --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
   --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
   --shadow-lg: 0 10px 20px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
   --shadow-xl: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12), 0 8px 16px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
   --shadow-2xl: 0 32px 64px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16);
   --shadow-ambient-teal: 0 24px 40px rgba(0, 102, 136, 0.06);
   --shadow-glow-cyan: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 194, 255, 0.25);
   --shadow-glow-orange: 0 8px 24px rgba(255, 141, 92, 0.30);
   --shadow-inner: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);

   /* ===== OPACITY ===== */
   --opacity-0: 0;
   --opacity-30: 0.3;
   --opacity-50: 0.5;
   --opacity-65: 0.65;
   --opacity-70: 0.7;
   --opacity-100: 1;

   /* ===== BLUR ===== */
   --blur-sm: 8px;
   --blur-md: 16px;
   --blur-lg: 24px;

   /* ===== MOTION — DURATION ===== */
   --motion-duration-fast: 150ms;
   --motion-duration-normal: 300ms;
   --motion-duration-slow: 500ms;
   --motion-duration-xslow: 800ms;

   /* ===== MOTION — EASING ===== */
   --motion-easing-linear: linear;
   --motion-easing-in: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1);
   --motion-easing-out: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1);
   --motion-easing-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

   /* ===== GRADIENTS BASE ===== */
   --gradient-cyan: linear-gradient(135deg, #00C2FF 0%, #4DCEFF 100%);
   --gradient-cyan-deep: linear-gradient(135deg, #006688 0%, #00C2FF 100%);
   --gradient-orange: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF8D5C 0%, #FF9466 100%);
   --gradient-cyan-orange: linear-gradient(90deg, #00C2FF 0%, #FF8D5C 100%);
   --gradient-teal-dark: linear-gradient(135deg, #001E2B 0%, #004C66 100%);
   --gradient-hero-card: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F2A2E 0%, #1A3F3F 50%, #2A5C50 100%);
   --gradient-skeleton: linear-gradient(90deg, #F0F4F8 25%, #EAEEF2 37%, #F0F4F8 63%);


   /* =======================================================================
      CAPA 2 — SEMANTIC / ALIAS TOKENS
      ======================================================================= */

   /* ===== COLOR — BACKGROUND ===== */
   --color-background-page: var(--color-slate-75);
   --color-background-surface: var(--color-white);
   --color-background-surface-low: var(--color-slate-150);
   --color-background-surface-medium: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-background-surface-high: var(--color-slate-250);
   --color-background-surface-highest: var(--color-slate-300);
   --color-background-surface-inverse: var(--color-teal-600);
   --color-background-surface-dark: var(--color-teal-900);
   --color-background-glass: var(--color-alpha-white-70);
   --color-background-overlay: var(--color-alpha-white-30);

   /* ===== COLOR — BRAND ===== */
   --color-brand-primary: var(--color-cyan-500);
   --color-brand-primary-hover: var(--color-cyan-600);
   --color-brand-primary-active: var(--color-cyan-700);
   --color-brand-primary-container: var(--color-cyan-50);
   --color-brand-primary-on: var(--color-white);
   --color-brand-primary-on-container: var(--color-cyan-800);
   --color-brand-primary-deep: var(--color-teal-500);
   --color-brand-primary-display: var(--color-teal-900);

   --color-brand-secondary: var(--color-orange-500);
   --color-brand-secondary-hover: var(--color-orange-400);
   --color-brand-secondary-active: var(--color-orange-600);
   --color-brand-secondary-container: var(--color-orange-100);
   --color-brand-secondary-on: var(--color-white);
   --color-brand-secondary-on-container: var(--color-orange-900);

   --color-brand-tertiary: var(--color-indigo-600);
   --color-brand-tertiary-container: var(--color-indigo-100);

   /* ===== COLOR — TEXT ===== */
   --color-text-primary: var(--color-slate-850);
   --color-text-secondary: var(--color-slate-700);
   --color-text-muted: var(--color-slate-600);
   --color-text-disabled: var(--color-slate-500);
   --color-text-inverse: var(--color-white);
   --color-text-display: var(--color-teal-900);
   --color-text-link: var(--color-cyan-700);
   --color-text-link-hover: var(--color-cyan-800);
   --color-text-accent: var(--color-cyan-500);

   /* ===== COLOR — BORDER ===== */
   --color-border-default: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-border-subtle: var(--color-slate-100);
   --color-border-strong: var(--color-slate-400);
   --color-border-focus: var(--color-cyan-500);
   --color-border-active: var(--color-cyan-500);
   --color-border-accent: var(--color-orange-500);
   --color-border-on-dark: var(--color-alpha-white-15);

   /* ===== COLOR — FEEDBACK ===== */
   --color-feedback-success: var(--color-green-500);
   --color-feedback-success-container: var(--color-green-100);
   --color-feedback-success-on: var(--color-green-700);
   --color-feedback-warning: var(--color-yellow-500);
   --color-feedback-warning-container: var(--color-yellow-100);
   --color-feedback-warning-on: var(--color-yellow-800);
   --color-feedback-error: var(--color-red-600);
   --color-feedback-error-container: var(--color-red-100);
   --color-feedback-error-on: var(--color-red-800);
   --color-feedback-info: var(--color-cyan-500);
   --color-feedback-info-container: var(--color-cyan-50);
   --color-feedback-info-on: var(--color-cyan-800);

   /* ===== COLOR — ICON ===== */
   --color-icon-default: var(--color-slate-700);
   --color-icon-muted: var(--color-slate-600);
   --color-icon-primary: var(--color-cyan-500);
   --color-icon-secondary: var(--color-orange-500);
   --color-icon-inverse: var(--color-white);

   /* ===== TYPOGRAPHY ===== */
   --typography-display-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-display-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   --typography-display-size: var(--font-size-5xl);
   --typography-display-line: var(--line-height-tight);
   --typography-display-tracking: var(--letter-spacing-tight);

   --typography-h1-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-h1-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   --typography-h1-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
   --typography-h1-line: var(--line-height-tight);
   --typography-h1-tracking: var(--letter-spacing-tight);

   --typography-h2-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-h2-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   --typography-h2-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
   --typography-h2-line: var(--line-height-snug);

   --typography-h3-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-h3-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   --typography-h3-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
   --typography-h3-line: var(--line-height-snug);

   --typography-h4-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-h4-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   --typography-h4-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   --typography-h4-line: var(--line-height-snug);

   --typography-body-family: var(--font-family-body);
   --typography-body-weight: var(--font-weight-regular);
   --typography-body-size: var(--font-size-base);
   --typography-body-line: var(--line-height-relaxed);

   --typography-body-sm-family: var(--font-family-body);
   --typography-body-sm-weight: var(--font-weight-regular);
   --typography-body-sm-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   --typography-body-sm-line: var(--line-height-relaxed);

   --typography-label-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-label-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   --typography-label-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   --typography-label-line: var(--line-height-none);
   --typography-label-tracking: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
   --typography-label-transform: uppercase;

   --typography-badge-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-badge-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   --typography-badge-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   --typography-badge-line: var(--line-height-none);
   --typography-badge-tracking: var(--letter-spacing-wider);
   --typography-badge-transform: uppercase;

   --typography-button-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   --typography-button-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   --typography-button-size: var(--font-size-base);
   --typography-button-line: var(--line-height-none);

   --typography-caption-family: var(--font-family-body);
   --typography-caption-weight: var(--font-weight-regular);
   --typography-caption-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   --typography-caption-line: var(--line-height-relaxed);

   /* ===== SPACING SEMANTIC ===== */
   --spacing-xs: var(--spacing-2);
   --spacing-sm: var(--spacing-4);
   --spacing-md: var(--spacing-6);
   --spacing-lg: var(--spacing-8);
   --spacing-xl: var(--spacing-12);
   --spacing-2xl: var(--spacing-16);
   --spacing-container: var(--spacing-8);
   --spacing-stack-gap: var(--spacing-4);
   --spacing-inline-gap: var(--spacing-3);

   /* ===== RADIUS SEMANTIC ===== */
   --radius-xs: var(--border-radius-md);
   --radius-sm: var(--border-radius-lg);
   --radius-md: var(--border-radius-2xl);
   --radius-lg: var(--border-radius-3xl);
   --radius-xl: var(--border-radius-4xl);
   --radius-2xl: var(--border-radius-5xl);
   --radius-pill: var(--border-radius-full);

   /* ===== SHADOW SEMANTIC ===== */
   --shadow-flat: var(--shadow-xs);
   --shadow-raised: var(--shadow-sm);
   --shadow-elevated: var(--shadow-md);
   --shadow-floating: var(--shadow-lg);
   --shadow-overlay: var(--shadow-xl);
   --shadow-modal: var(--shadow-2xl);
   --shadow-ambient: var(--shadow-ambient-teal);
   --shadow-focus-primary: var(--shadow-glow-cyan);
   --shadow-focus-secondary: var(--shadow-glow-orange);

   /* ===== MOTION SEMANTIC ===== */
   --motion-duration-instant: var(--motion-duration-fast);
   --motion-duration-default: var(--motion-duration-normal);
   --motion-duration-emphasis: var(--motion-duration-slow);
   --motion-duration-entrance: var(--motion-duration-xslow);
   --motion-easing-standard: var(--motion-easing-in-out);
   --motion-easing-decelerate: var(--motion-easing-out);
   --motion-easing-accelerate: var(--motion-easing-in);


   /* =======================================================================
      CAPA 3 — COMPONENT / MAPPED TOKENS
      ======================================================================= */

   /* ===== BUTTON — PRIMARY / CTA NARANJA ===== */
   --color-background-button-primary-default: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   --color-background-button-primary-hover: var(--color-brand-secondary-hover);
   --color-background-button-primary-active: var(--color-brand-secondary-active);
   --color-background-button-primary-disabled: var(--color-slate-300);
   --color-text-button-primary-default: var(--color-white);
   --color-text-button-primary-disabled: var(--color-slate-500);
   --border-radius-button-primary: var(--radius-pill);
   --padding-x-button-primary: var(--spacing-8);
   --padding-y-button-primary: var(--spacing-3);
   --shadow-button-primary-default: var(--shadow-focus-secondary);
   --shadow-button-primary-hover: var(--shadow-overlay);
   --transform-button-primary-hover: translateY(-2px);
   --motion-duration-button-primary: var(--motion-duration-default);
   --motion-easing-button-primary: var(--motion-easing-standard);

   /* ===== BUTTON — SECONDARY / CYAN ===== */
   --color-background-button-secondary-default: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-background-button-secondary-hover: var(--color-brand-primary-hover);
   --color-background-button-secondary-active: var(--color-brand-primary-active);
   --color-background-button-secondary-disabled: var(--color-slate-300);
   --color-text-button-secondary-default: var(--color-white);
   --color-text-button-secondary-disabled: var(--color-slate-500);
   --border-radius-button-secondary: var(--radius-pill);
   --padding-x-button-secondary: var(--spacing-8);
   --padding-y-button-secondary: var(--spacing-3);
   --shadow-button-secondary-default: var(--shadow-focus-primary);

   /* ===== BUTTON — TERTIARY / OUTLINE ===== */
   --color-background-button-tertiary-default: var(--color-white);
   --color-background-button-tertiary-hover: var(--color-slate-50);
   --color-border-button-tertiary-default: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-text-button-tertiary-default: var(--color-text-primary);
   --border-radius-button-tertiary: var(--radius-pill);
   --border-width-button-tertiary: var(--border-width-1);
   --padding-x-button-tertiary: var(--spacing-6);
   --padding-y-button-tertiary: var(--spacing-3);

   /* ===== BUTTON — GHOST ===== */
   --color-background-button-ghost-default: transparent;
   --color-background-button-ghost-hover: var(--color-slate-100);
   --color-text-button-ghost-default: var(--color-text-secondary);
   --color-text-button-ghost-hover: var(--color-text-primary);

   /* ===== CARD — DEFAULT ===== */
   --color-background-card-default: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-border-card-default: var(--color-border-subtle);
   --border-width-card-default: var(--border-width-1);
   --border-radius-card-default: var(--radius-lg);
   --padding-card-default: var(--spacing-8);
   --shadow-card-default: var(--shadow-elevated);

   /* ===== CARD — MODULE / DASHBOARD ===== */
   --color-background-card-module: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-border-card-module-top-cyan: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-border-card-module-top-orange: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   --color-border-card-module-default: var(--color-border-subtle);
   --border-width-card-module-top: var(--border-width-4);
   --border-radius-card-module: var(--radius-xl);
   --padding-card-module: var(--spacing-8);
   --shadow-card-module: var(--shadow-floating);

   /* ===== CARD — MODULE STATES ===== */
   --color-background-card-module-completed: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-background-card-module-current: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-background-card-module-locked: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
   --color-text-card-module-locked: var(--color-slate-500);
   --color-border-card-module-locked: var(--color-slate-200);
   --opacity-card-module-locked: var(--opacity-65);
   --color-icon-module-locked: var(--color-slate-500);
   --color-background-icon-module-locked: var(--color-slate-200);

   /* ===== CARD — FEATURE / HABILIDADES, ACTIVIDADES, RESUMEN ===== */
   --color-background-card-feature: var(--color-background-surface);
   --border-radius-card-feature: var(--radius-xl);
   --padding-card-feature: var(--spacing-8);
   --shadow-card-feature: var(--shadow-floating);

   /* ===== CARD — INVERSE / GUÍA DE BOLSILLO ===== */
   --color-background-card-inverse: var(--color-teal-600);
   --color-text-card-inverse-title: var(--color-white);
   --color-text-card-inverse-body: var(--color-alpha-white-80);
   --border-radius-card-inverse: var(--radius-xl);
   --padding-card-inverse: var(--spacing-8);
   --shadow-card-inverse: var(--shadow-elevated);

   /* ===== CARD — HERO GRADIENT / RECURSO DESTACADO ===== */
   --color-background-card-hero-gradient: var(--gradient-hero-card);
   --color-text-card-hero-default: var(--color-white);
   --border-radius-card-hero: var(--radius-2xl);
   --padding-card-hero: var(--spacing-12);

   /* ===== CARD — GLASS ===== */
   --color-background-card-glass: var(--color-background-glass);
   --color-border-card-glass: var(--color-alpha-white-30);
   --border-width-card-glass: var(--border-width-1);
   --blur-card-glass: var(--blur-lg);

   /* ===== CARD — ANNOUNCEMENT ===== */
   --color-background-card-announcement: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-background-card-announcement-disabled: var(--color-slate-50);
   --color-border-card-announcement-accent: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-border-card-announcement-info: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-border-card-announcement-warning: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   --color-border-card-announcement-neutral: var(--color-slate-350);
   --color-text-card-announcement-disabled: var(--color-slate-500);
   --border-style-card-announcement-neutral: dashed;
   --border-width-card-announcement-accent: var(--border-width-4);
   --border-radius-card-announcement: var(--radius-md);
   --padding-card-announcement: var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-6);
   --shadow-card-announcement: var(--shadow-flat);

   /* ===== CARD — REFLECTION ===== */
   --color-background-card-reflection: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-border-card-reflection: var(--color-border-default);
   --color-border-card-reflection-accent: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   --border-width-card-reflection: var(--border-width-1);
   --border-width-card-reflection-accent: var(--border-width-6);
   --border-radius-card-reflection: var(--radius-lg);
   --padding-card-reflection: var(--spacing-12);
   --shadow-card-reflection: var(--shadow-ambient);
   --color-text-card-reflection-badge: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   --color-text-card-reflection-question: var(--color-text-primary);
   --color-text-card-reflection-instruction: var(--color-text-secondary);
   --color-text-card-reflection-footer: var(--color-text-muted);
   --color-border-card-reflection-question: var(--color-brand-secondary-container);
   --border-width-card-reflection-question: var(--border-width-3);

   /* ===== CARD — QUESTION / CHECKPOINT ===== */
   --color-background-card-question: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-border-card-question-accent: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --border-width-card-question-accent: var(--border-width-6);
   --border-radius-card-question: var(--radius-lg);
   --padding-card-question: var(--spacing-8);
   --shadow-card-question: var(--shadow-elevated);

   /* ===== CARD — ANSWER OPTION ===== */
   --color-background-card-answer-default: var(--color-slate-150);
   --color-background-card-answer-hover: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-background-card-answer-selected: var(--color-cyan-50);
   --color-border-card-answer-selected: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --border-radius-card-answer: var(--radius-md);
   --padding-card-answer: var(--spacing-5);

   /* ===== HEADER / TOPBAR ===== */
   --color-background-header-gradient: var(--gradient-cyan-deep);
   --color-background-header-solid: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-text-header-on-gradient: var(--color-white);
   --color-text-header-on-solid: var(--color-text-primary);
   --color-border-header-bottom: var(--color-border-default);
   --padding-y-header: var(--spacing-4);
   --padding-x-header: var(--spacing-8);
   --height-header: var(--size-topbar-height);

   /* ===== SIDEBAR ===== */
   --color-background-sidebar-default: var(--color-background-surface);
   --color-background-sidebar-rail: var(--color-background-surface);
   --size-width-sidebar: var(--size-sidebar-width);
   --size-width-sidebar-rail: var(--size-sidebar-rail);
   --border-radius-sidebar-right: var(--border-radius-3xl);
   --padding-sidebar: var(--spacing-4);
   --shadow-sidebar: var(--shadow-lg);

   --color-background-sidebar-item-default: transparent;
   --color-background-sidebar-item-hover: var(--color-slate-50);
   --color-background-sidebar-item-active: var(--color-cyan-500);
   --color-text-sidebar-item-default: var(--color-text-secondary);
   --color-text-sidebar-item-hover: var(--color-text-primary);
   --color-text-sidebar-item-active: var(--color-white);
   --color-icon-sidebar-item-default: var(--color-icon-muted);
   --color-icon-sidebar-item-active: var(--color-white);
   --border-radius-sidebar-item: var(--radius-sm);
   --padding-x-sidebar-item: var(--spacing-3);
   --padding-y-sidebar-item: var(--spacing-3);
   --gap-sidebar-item: var(--spacing-3);

   /* ===== INPUT ===== */
   --color-background-input-default: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-background-input-focus: var(--color-white);
   --color-background-input-disabled: var(--color-slate-150);
   --color-border-input-default: transparent;
   --color-border-input-hover: var(--color-slate-350);
   --color-border-input-focus: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-border-input-error: var(--color-feedback-error);
   --color-text-input-default: var(--color-text-primary);
   --color-text-input-placeholder: var(--color-text-disabled);
   --color-icon-input-default: var(--color-icon-muted);
   --border-radius-input-default: var(--radius-pill);
   --border-width-input-default: var(--border-width-1);
   --border-width-input-focus: var(--border-width-2);
   --padding-x-input-default: var(--spacing-5);
   --padding-y-input-default: var(--spacing-3);
   --shadow-input-focus: var(--shadow-focus-primary);

   /* ===== SEARCH BAR ===== */
   --color-background-searchbar: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-border-searchbar: transparent;
   --color-text-searchbar: var(--color-text-primary);
   --color-text-searchbar-placeholder: var(--color-text-muted);
   --color-icon-searchbar: var(--color-icon-muted);
   --border-radius-searchbar: var(--radius-pill);
   --padding-x-searchbar: var(--spacing-5);
   --padding-y-searchbar: var(--spacing-3);

   /* ===== BADGE / PILL ===== */
   --color-background-badge-info: var(--color-cyan-50);
   --color-text-badge-info: var(--color-cyan-800);
   --color-background-badge-success: var(--color-green-100);
   --color-text-badge-success: var(--color-green-700);
   --color-background-badge-neutral: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-text-badge-neutral: var(--color-text-secondary);
   --color-background-badge-warning: var(--color-feedback-warning-container);
   --color-text-badge-warning: var(--color-feedback-warning-on);
   --border-radius-badge: var(--radius-pill);
   --padding-x-badge: var(--spacing-3);
   --padding-y-badge: var(--spacing-1);

   /* ===== PROGRESS BAR ===== */
   --color-background-progress-track: var(--color-slate-100);
   --color-background-progress-fill: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-background-progress-fill-success: var(--color-green-500);
   --color-background-progress-fill-gradient: var(--gradient-cyan-orange);
   --border-radius-progress: var(--border-radius-full);
   --size-height-progress: var(--size-progress-height);
   --size-height-progress-lg: var(--size-progress-height-lg);

   /* ===== PROGRESS RING ===== */
   --color-stroke-progress-ring-track: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-stroke-progress-ring-fill: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-stroke-progress-ring-warn: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   --width-stroke-progress-ring: 8px;

   /* ===== TOGGLE / SWITCH ===== */
   --color-background-toggle-off: var(--color-slate-300);
   --color-background-toggle-on: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-background-toggle-handle: var(--color-white);
   --shadow-toggle-handle: var(--shadow-sm);
   --border-radius-toggle: var(--border-radius-full);

   /* ===== CHECKBOX ===== */
   --color-background-checkbox-unchecked: var(--color-white);
   --color-background-checkbox-checked: var(--color-teal-700);
   --color-border-checkbox-default: var(--color-slate-400);
   --color-border-checkbox-checked: var(--color-teal-700);
   --color-icon-checkbox-checked: var(--color-white);
   --border-radius-checkbox: var(--border-radius-md);
   --border-width-checkbox: var(--border-width-2);

   /* ===== TAB / NAV LINK ===== */
   --color-text-tab-default: var(--color-text-secondary);
   --color-text-tab-active: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --color-text-tab-hover: var(--color-text-primary);
   --color-border-tab-active: var(--color-brand-primary);
   --border-width-tab-active: var(--border-width-2);
   --padding-y-tab: var(--spacing-2);

   /* ===== AVATAR ===== */
   --size-avatar-default: var(--size-avatar-md);
   --border-radius-avatar: var(--border-radius-full);
   --color-border-avatar-online: var(--color-feedback-success);
   --border-width-avatar-status: var(--border-width-2);

   /* ===== CONTAINER ===== */
   --size-max-container: var(--size-container-max);
   --padding-x-container: var(--spacing-8);

   /* ===== ICON CONTAINER ===== */
   --size-icon-container-default: var(--size-icon-container);
   --color-background-icon-container-cyan: var(--color-cyan-50);
   --color-background-icon-container-orange: var(--color-orange-100);
   --color-background-icon-container-indigo: var(--color-indigo-100);
   --color-background-icon-container-neutral: var(--color-slate-150);
   --border-radius-icon-container: var(--radius-sm);

   /* ===== AUTH / LOGIN ===== */
   --color-background-auth-page: var(--color-slate-75);
   --color-background-auth-shell: var(--color-white);
   --color-background-auth-panel-left: var(--gradient-cyan-deep);
   --color-background-auth-panel-right: var(--color-white);
   --color-background-auth-input: var(--color-slate-200);
   --color-text-auth-title: var(--color-white);
   --color-text-auth-body: var(--color-alpha-white-80);
   --color-text-auth-form-title: var(--color-text-display);
   --color-text-auth-form-body: var(--color-text-muted);
   --border-radius-auth-shell: var(--radius-2xl);
   --border-radius-auth-panel-left: var(--radius-2xl);
   --border-radius-auth-image: var(--border-radius-none);
   --padding-auth-shell: var(--spacing-0);
   --padding-auth-panel: var(--spacing-12);
   --shadow-auth-shell: var(--shadow-xl);
   --size-auth-shell-max-width: var(--size-auth-shell-max);

   /* ===== SKELETON / PLACEHOLDERS ===== */
   --color-background-skeleton: var(--color-slate-150);
   --color-background-skeleton-highlight: var(--color-slate-200);
   --gradient-background-skeleton: var(--gradient-skeleton);
   --border-radius-skeleton: var(--radius-pill);

   /* ===== ANIMATION ===== */
   --animation-fade-in-duration: var(--motion-duration-entrance);
   --animation-fade-in-easing: var(--motion-easing-standard);
   --animation-slide-up-duration: var(--motion-duration-emphasis);
   --animation-pulse-duration: 2s;
}


/* ========================================================================== 
   KEYFRAMES — ANIMACIONES REUTILIZABLES
   ========================================================================== */

@keyframes fade-in {
   from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
   }

   to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
   }
}

@keyframes slide-up {
   from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(40px);
   }

   to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
   }
}

@keyframes pulse-glow {

   0%,
   100% {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--color-alpha-cyan-30);
   }

   50% {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px transparent;
   }
}

@keyframes shimmer {
   0% {
      background-position: -200% 0;
   }

   100% {
      background-position: 200% 0;
   }
}


/* ========================================================================== 
   BASE — CONFIGURACIÓN GENERAL
   ========================================================================== */

* {
   box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
   font-family: var(--font-family-body);
   background-color: var(--color-background-page);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

body {
   margin: 0;
   background-color: var(--color-background-page);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
   font-family: var(--font-family-body);
   font-size: var(--font-size-base);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

button,
input,
textarea,
select {
   font: inherit;
}

button {
   cursor: pointer;
}

img {
   max-width: 100%;
   display: block;
}


/* ========================================================================== 
   UTILITY CLASSES — DOCENCIA 4.0
   Basado en Design Tokens: Global, Semantic y Component
   ========================================================================== */

/* ----- 1. CONTENEDORES Y SUPERFICIES ----- */
.bg-page {
   background-color: var(--color-background-page);
}

.bg-surface {
   background-color: var(--color-background-surface);
}

.bg-surface-low {
   background-color: var(--color-background-surface-low);
}

.bg-surface-medium {
   background-color: var(--color-background-surface-medium);
}

.bg-inverse {
   background-color: var(--color-background-surface-inverse);
}

.bg-glass {
   background-color: var(--color-background-glass);
   backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-lg));
}

.container-app {
   width: 100%;
   max-width: var(--size-max-container);
   margin-inline: auto;
   padding-inline: var(--padding-x-container);
}

/* ----- 2. TIPOGRAFÍA ----- */
.text-display {
   font-family: var(--typography-display-family);
   font-weight: var(--typography-display-weight);
   font-size: var(--typography-display-size);
   line-height: var(--typography-display-line);
   letter-spacing: var(--typography-display-tracking);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
}

.text-display-dashboard {
   font-family: var(--typography-display-family);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   font-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-tight);
}

.text-display-auth {
   font-family: var(--typography-display-family);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   font-size: var(--font-size-5xl);
   color: var(--color-white);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-tight);
}

.text-h1 {
   font-family: var(--typography-h1-family);
   font-weight: var(--typography-h1-weight);
   font-size: var(--typography-h1-size);
   line-height: var(--typography-h1-line);
   letter-spacing: var(--typography-h1-tracking);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
}

.text-h2 {
   font-family: var(--typography-h2-family);
   font-weight: var(--typography-h2-weight);
   font-size: var(--typography-h2-size);
   line-height: var(--typography-h2-line);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.text-h3 {
   font-family: var(--typography-h3-family);
   font-weight: var(--typography-h3-weight);
   font-size: var(--typography-h3-size);
   line-height: var(--typography-h3-line);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.text-h4 {
   font-family: var(--typography-h4-family);
   font-weight: var(--typography-h4-weight);
   font-size: var(--typography-h4-size);
   line-height: var(--typography-h4-line);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.text-body {
   font-family: var(--typography-body-family);
   font-size: var(--typography-body-size);
   font-weight: var(--typography-body-weight);
   line-height: var(--typography-body-line);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.text-body-sm {
   font-family: var(--typography-body-sm-family);
   font-size: var(--typography-body-sm-size);
   font-weight: var(--typography-body-sm-weight);
   line-height: var(--typography-body-sm-line);
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.text-caption {
   font-family: var(--typography-caption-family);
   font-size: var(--typography-caption-size);
   font-weight: var(--typography-caption-weight);
   line-height: var(--typography-caption-line);
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.text-label {
   font-family: var(--typography-label-family);
   font-weight: var(--typography-label-weight);
   font-size: var(--typography-label-size);
   line-height: var(--typography-label-line);
   letter-spacing: var(--typography-label-tracking);
   text-transform: var(--typography-label-transform);
}

.text-muted {
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.text-secondary {
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.text-disabled {
   color: var(--color-text-disabled);
}

.text-brand {
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.text-link {
   color: var(--color-text-link);
   text-decoration: none;
}

.text-link:hover {
   color: var(--color-text-link-hover);
}

/* ----- 3. LOGO Y BRANDING ----- */
.logo-container {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-3);
   padding: var(--spacing-4);
}

.logo-img {
   height: var(--size-icon-container);
   width: auto;
   object-fit: contain;
}

.logo-text {
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
}

/* ----- 4. BORDES Y SOMBRAS ----- */
.shadow-card {
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated);
}

.shadow-floating {
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.shadow-overlay {
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
}

.radius-sm {
   border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.radius-md {
   border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}

.radius-lg {
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}

.radius-xl {
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
}

.radius-pill {
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
}

.border-t-cyan {
   border-top: var(--border-width-card-module-top) solid var(--color-border-card-module-top-cyan);
}

.border-t-orange {
   border-top: var(--border-width-card-module-top) solid var(--color-border-card-module-top-orange);
}

/* ----- 5. BOTONES ----- */
.btn {
   display: inline-flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-2);
   min-height: 48px;
   padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-8);
   border: none;
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   font-family: var(--typography-button-family);
   font-size: var(--typography-button-size);
   font-weight: var(--typography-button-weight);
   line-height: var(--typography-button-line);
   text-decoration: none;
   transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.btn-primary {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-primary-default);
   color: var(--color-text-button-primary-default);
   padding: var(--padding-y-button-primary) var(--padding-x-button-primary);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-button-primary);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-button-primary-default);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-primary-hover);
   transform: var(--transform-button-primary-hover);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-button-primary-hover);
}

.btn-primary:active {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-primary-active);
   transform: translateY(0);
}

.btn-primary:disabled,
.btn-primary.is-disabled {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-primary-disabled);
   color: var(--color-text-button-primary-disabled);
   box-shadow: none;
   cursor: not-allowed;
   transform: none;
}

.btn-secondary {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-secondary-default);
   color: var(--color-text-button-secondary-default);
   padding: var(--padding-y-button-secondary) var(--padding-x-button-secondary);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-button-secondary);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-button-secondary-default);
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-secondary-hover);
   transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-tertiary {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-tertiary-default);
   color: var(--color-text-button-tertiary-default);
   border: var(--border-width-button-tertiary) solid var(--color-border-button-tertiary-default);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-button-tertiary);
   padding: var(--padding-y-button-tertiary) var(--padding-x-button-tertiary);
}

.btn-tertiary:hover {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-tertiary-hover);
}

.btn-ghost {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-ghost-default);
   color: var(--color-text-button-ghost-default);
}

.btn-ghost:hover {
   background-color: var(--color-background-button-ghost-hover);
   color: var(--color-text-button-ghost-hover);
}

/* ----- 6. TARJETAS ----- */
.card {
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-default);
   border: var(--border-width-card-default) solid var(--color-border-card-default);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-card-default);
   padding: var(--padding-card-default);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-default);
}

.card-module {
   position: relative;
   overflow: hidden;
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-module);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-card-module-default);
   border-top-width: var(--border-width-card-module-top);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-card-module);
   padding: var(--padding-card-module);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-module);
}

.card-module.is-cyan {
   border-top-color: var(--color-border-card-module-top-cyan);
}

.card-module.is-orange {
   border-top-color: var(--color-border-card-module-top-orange);
}

.card-module.is-locked {
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-module-locked);
   border-color: var(--color-border-card-module-locked);
   color: var(--color-text-card-module-locked);
   opacity: var(--opacity-card-module-locked);
}

.card-feature {
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-feature);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-card-feature);
   padding: var(--padding-card-feature);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-feature);
}

.card-inverse {
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-inverse);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-card-inverse);
   padding: var(--padding-card-inverse);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-inverse);
   color: var(--color-text-card-inverse-body);
}

.card-inverse-title {
   color: var(--color-text-card-inverse-title);
}

.card-hero {
   background: var(--color-background-card-hero-gradient);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-card-hero);
   padding: var(--padding-card-hero);
   color: var(--color-text-card-hero-default);
}

.card-glass {
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-glass);
   border: var(--border-width-card-glass) solid var(--color-border-card-glass);
   backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-card-glass));
}

/* ----- 7. ANUNCIOS ----- */
.card-announcement {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-3);
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-announcement);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-left: var(--border-width-card-announcement-accent) solid var(--color-border-card-announcement-accent);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-card-announcement);
   padding: var(--padding-card-announcement);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-announcement);
}

.card-announcement.is-info {
   border-left-color: var(--color-border-card-announcement-info);
}

.card-announcement.is-warning {
   border-left-color: var(--color-border-card-announcement-warning);
}

.card-announcement.is-neutral {
   border-style: var(--border-style-card-announcement-neutral);
   border-left-color: var(--color-border-card-announcement-neutral);
}

.card-announcement.is-disabled {
   background-color: var(--color-background-card-announcement-disabled);
   color: var(--color-text-card-announcement-disabled);
}

/* ----- 8. HEADER / TOPBAR ----- */
.app-header {
   height: var(--height-header);
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: space-between;
   padding: var(--padding-y-header) var(--padding-x-header);
   background-color: var(--color-background-header-solid);
   color: var(--color-text-header-on-solid);
   border-bottom: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-header-bottom);
}

.app-header.is-gradient {
   background: var(--color-background-header-gradient);
   color: var(--color-text-header-on-gradient);
}

/* ----- 9. SIDEBAR ----- */
.sidebar {
   width: var(--size-width-sidebar);
   background-color: var(--color-background-sidebar-default);
   border-radius: 0 var(--border-radius-sidebar-right) var(--border-radius-sidebar-right) 0;
   padding: var(--padding-sidebar);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-sidebar);
}

.sidebar-rail {
   width: var(--size-width-sidebar-rail);
   background-color: var(--color-background-sidebar-rail);
}

.sidebar-item {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   gap: var(--gap-sidebar-item);
   padding: var(--padding-y-sidebar-item) var(--padding-x-sidebar-item);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-sidebar-item);
   background-color: var(--color-background-sidebar-item-default);
   color: var(--color-text-sidebar-item-default);
   transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.sidebar-item:hover {
   background-color: var(--color-background-sidebar-item-hover);
   color: var(--color-text-sidebar-item-hover);
}

.sidebar-item.is-active {
   background-color: var(--color-background-sidebar-item-active);
   color: var(--color-text-sidebar-item-active);
}

/* ----- 10. INPUTS Y SEARCH ----- */
.input {
   width: 100%;
   min-height: 56px;
   padding: var(--padding-y-input-default) var(--padding-x-input-default);
   background-color: var(--color-background-input-default);
   color: var(--color-text-input-default);
   border: var(--border-width-input-default) solid var(--color-border-input-default);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-input-default);
   outline: none;
   transition: border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.input::placeholder {
   color: var(--color-text-input-placeholder);
}

.input:hover {
   border-color: var(--color-border-input-hover);
}

.input:focus {
   background-color: var(--color-background-input-focus);
   border-width: var(--border-width-input-focus);
   border-color: var(--color-border-input-focus);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-input-focus);
}

.input:disabled {
   background-color: var(--color-background-input-disabled);
   color: var(--color-text-disabled);
   cursor: not-allowed;
}

.searchbar {
   width: 100%;
   min-height: 48px;
   padding: var(--padding-y-searchbar) var(--padding-x-searchbar);
   background-color: var(--color-background-searchbar);
   color: var(--color-text-searchbar);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-searchbar);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-searchbar);
   outline: none;
}

.searchbar::placeholder {
   color: var(--color-text-searchbar-placeholder);
}

/* ----- 11. BADGES ----- */
.badge {
   display: inline-flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-1);
   padding: var(--padding-y-badge) var(--padding-x-badge);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-badge);
   font-family: var(--typography-badge-family);
   font-size: var(--typography-badge-size);
   font-weight: var(--typography-badge-weight);
   line-height: var(--typography-badge-line);
   letter-spacing: var(--typography-badge-tracking);
   text-transform: var(--typography-badge-transform);
}

.badge-info {
   background-color: var(--color-background-badge-info);
   color: var(--color-text-badge-info);
}

.badge-success {
   background-color: var(--color-background-badge-success);
   color: var(--color-text-badge-success);
}

.badge-neutral {
   background-color: var(--color-background-badge-neutral);
   color: var(--color-text-badge-neutral);
}

.badge-warning {
   background-color: var(--color-background-badge-warning);
   color: var(--color-text-badge-warning);
}

/* ----- 12. PROGRESS ----- */
.progress {
   width: 100%;
   height: var(--size-height-progress);
   background-color: var(--color-background-progress-track);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-progress);
   overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill {
   height: 100%;
   background-color: var(--color-background-progress-fill);
   border-radius: inherit;
   transition: width var(--motion-duration-emphasis) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.progress-fill.is-success {
   background-color: var(--color-background-progress-fill-success);
}

.progress-fill.is-gradient {
   background: var(--color-background-progress-fill-gradient);
}

.progress-lg {
   height: var(--size-height-progress-lg);
}

/* ----- 13. ICON CONTAINER ----- */
.icon-container {
   width: var(--size-icon-container-default);
   height: var(--size-icon-container-default);
   display: inline-flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-icon-container);
}

.icon-container-cyan {
   background-color: var(--color-background-icon-container-cyan);
   color: var(--color-icon-primary);
}

.icon-container-orange {
   background-color: var(--color-background-icon-container-orange);
   color: var(--color-icon-secondary);
}

.icon-container-indigo {
   background-color: var(--color-background-icon-container-indigo);
   color: var(--color-brand-tertiary);
}

.icon-container-neutral {
   background-color: var(--color-background-icon-container-neutral);
   color: var(--color-icon-muted);
}

.icon-container-locked {
   background-color: var(--color-background-icon-module-locked);
   color: var(--color-icon-module-locked);
}

/* ----- 14. AUTH / LOGIN ----- */
.auth-page {
   min-height: 100vh;
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   padding: var(--spacing-12);
   background-color: var(--color-background-auth-page);
}

.auth-shell {
   width: 100%;
   max-width: var(--size-auth-shell-max-width);
   display: grid;
   grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
   overflow: hidden;
   background-color: var(--color-background-auth-shell);
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-auth-shell);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-auth-shell);
}

.auth-panel-left {
   min-height: 720px;
   padding: var(--padding-auth-panel);
   background: var(--color-background-auth-panel-left);
   color: var(--color-text-auth-body);
}

.auth-panel-right {
   padding: var(--padding-auth-panel);
   background-color: var(--color-background-auth-panel-right);
}

.auth-title {
   color: var(--color-text-auth-title);
}

.auth-body {
   color: var(--color-text-auth-body);
}

.auth-form-title {
   color: var(--color-text-auth-form-title);
}

.auth-form-body {
   color: var(--color-text-auth-form-body);
}

.auth-image {
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-auth-image);
   overflow: hidden;
}

/* ----- 15. SKELETON / PLACEHOLDERS ----- */
.skeleton {
   min-height: 16px;
   border-radius: var(--border-radius-skeleton);
   background: var(--gradient-background-skeleton);
   background-size: 200% 100%;
   animation: shimmer 1.5s infinite linear;
}

.skeleton-pill {
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
}

.skeleton-box {
   border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}

/* ----- 16. ANIMACIONES ----- */
.animate-fade-in {
   animation: fade-in var(--animation-fade-in-duration) var(--animation-fade-in-easing) both;
}

.animate-slide-up {
   animation: slide-up var(--animation-slide-up-duration) var(--motion-easing-standard) both;
}

.animate-pulse-glow {
   animation: pulse-glow var(--animation-pulse-duration) infinite;
}

/* ----- 17. RESPONSIVE ----- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
   :root {
      --padding-x-container: var(--spacing-6);
      --padding-auth-panel: var(--spacing-8);
   }

   .auth-shell {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
   }

   .auth-panel-left {
      min-height: auto;
   }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
   :root {
      --padding-x-container: var(--spacing-4);
      --typography-display-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
      --typography-h1-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
      --typography-h2-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
      --border-radius-auth-shell: var(--radius-lg);
   }

   .auth-page {
      padding: var(--spacing-4);
   }

   .text-display-auth,
   .text-display-dashboard {
      font-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
   }

   .card-module,
   .card-feature,
   .card-inverse {
      padding: var(--spacing-6);
   }
}


/* ==========================================================================
   DOCENCIA 4.0 — COMPONENTES EDUCATIVOS Y LMS
   Uso recomendado:
   - No redefinir estos estilos dentro de cada HTML.
   - Usar este bloque como fuente común para top-nav, module-sidebar,
     lesson-card, recursos, iframes, foros, modales y navegación final.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
   /* ===== LAYOUT EDUCATIVO ===== */
   --height-module-topnav: 80px;
   --size-logo-topbar-height: 56px;
   --size-module-sidebar-width: 320px;
   --size-content-readable: 1100px;

   /* ===== ALPHA COMPLEMENTARIO PARA OVERLAYS Y MODALES ===== */
   --color-alpha-black-40: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.40);
   --color-alpha-black-70: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70);
   --color-alpha-black-90: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.90);
}

/* ----- ACCESSIBILITY HELPERS ----- */
.sr-only {
   position: absolute;
   width: 1px;
   height: 1px;
   padding: 0;
   margin: -1px;
   overflow: hidden;
   clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
   white-space: nowrap;
   border: 0;
}

.menu-btn:focus-visible,
.menu-links a:focus-visible,
.btn-footer:focus-visible,
.btn-scroll-top:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
a:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible,
iframe:focus-visible {
   outline: var(--border-width-2) solid var(--color-border-focus);
   outline-offset: var(--spacing-1);
}

/* ----- TOP NAV EDUCATIVO ----- */
.top-nav {
   position: fixed;
   top: 0;
   left: 0;
   right: 0;
   z-index: 1000;
   height: var(--height-module-topnav);
   min-height: var(--height-module-topnav);
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: space-between;
   padding: 0 var(--spacing-md);
   background: var(--color-alpha-white-90);
   backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-lg));
   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-lg));
   border-bottom: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
}

.nav-left {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-sm);
   min-width: 0;
}

.top-nav .logo-container {
   padding: 0;
}

.top-nav .logo-container img,
.logo-img-topbar {
   height: var(--size-logo-topbar-height);
   width: auto;
   display: block;
   object-fit: contain;
   flex-shrink: 0;
}

.module-title-nav {
   max-width: 65vw;
   overflow: hidden;
   padding-left: var(--spacing-sm);
   margin-left: var(--spacing-xs);
   border-left: var(--border-width-2) solid var(--color-border-default);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-base);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
   white-space: nowrap;
   text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.menu-btn {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   padding: var(--spacing-2);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-md);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-medium);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   cursor: pointer;
   transition:
      background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.menu-btn:hover {
   background: var(--color-brand-primary);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
   transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ----- MODULE SIDEBAR / MENÚ LATERAL ----- */
.module-sidebar {
   position: fixed;
   top: 0;
   left: calc(-1 * var(--size-module-sidebar-width) - 20px);
   z-index: 2000;
   width: var(--size-module-sidebar-width);
   height: 100vh;
   padding: var(--spacing-lg) var(--spacing-md);
   overflow-y: auto;
   background: var(--color-background-surface-dark);
   color: var(--color-text-inverse);
   transition:
      left var(--motion-duration-emphasis) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.module-sidebar.active {
   left: 0;
   box-shadow: 20px 0 50px var(--color-alpha-black-15);
}

.module-sidebar-overlay {
   position: fixed;
   inset: 0;
   z-index: 1999;
   display: none;
   background: var(--color-alpha-black-40);
   backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm));
   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm));
}

.module-sidebar-overlay.active {
   display: block;
}

.side-menu-title {
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-md);
   color: var(--color-text-inverse);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
}

.menu-links {
   list-style: none;
   padding: 0;
   margin: 0;
}

.menu-links li {
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xs);
}

.menu-section-label {
   display: block;
   padding: var(--spacing-5) var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-2);
   color: var(--color-cyan-100);
   font-family: var(--font-family-body);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wider);
   text-transform: uppercase;
   opacity: 0.9;
}

.menu-links a {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-3);
   padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
   border-radius: var(--radius-md);
   color: var(--color-alpha-white-70);
   font-family: var(--font-family-body);
   font-size: var(--font-size-base);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
   text-decoration: none;
   transition:
      background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.menu-links a:hover {
   background: var(--color-alpha-white-15);
   color: var(--color-cyan-100);
}

.menu-links a.active,
.menu-links a[aria-current="page"] {
   background: var(--color-brand-primary);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
}

/* ----- PAGE / LESSON / ACTIVITY LAYOUT ----- */
body.has-top-nav {
   padding-top: var(--height-module-topnav);
}

/* ----- DASHBOARD SHELL ----- */
.dashboard-header {
   position: sticky;
   top: 0;
   z-index: 1000;
   padding: var(--spacing-lg) 0;
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
   border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl);
   background: var(--color-background-header-gradient);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
   transition: all var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.dashboard-header.is-scrolled {
   padding: var(--spacing-2) 0;
   background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-primary) 68%, transparent);
   backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%);
   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%);
   border-radius: 0;
   box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.10);
   border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-background-surface) 28%, transparent);
}

.dashboard-header.is-scrolled .logo-main {
   width: 48px;
   height: 48px;
   padding: var(--spacing-1);
}

.dashboard-header.is-scrolled .dashboard-title {
   font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   margin-bottom: 0;
}

.dashboard-header.is-scrolled .header-subtitle {
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   margin-top: 0;
   opacity: 0.9;
   white-space: nowrap;
   overflow: hidden;
   text-overflow: ellipsis;
   max-width: 500px;
}

.dashboard-page .dashboard-nav-links {
   display: flex;
   gap: var(--spacing-6);
   align-items: center;
}

.dashboard-page .dashboard-header.is-scrolled .dashboard-nav-links {
   margin-top: 0;
   gap: var(--spacing-4);
}

.dashboard-page .dashboard-header .dashboard-profile-link {
   color: var(--color-text-header-on-gradient);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   text-decoration: none;
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-2);
   transition: all var(--motion-duration-normal);
}

.dashboard-page .dashboard-header.is-scrolled .dashboard-profile-link,
.dashboard-page .dashboard-header.is-scrolled .dashboard-nav-links a {
   color: var(--color-text-inverse);
   opacity: 1;
}

.dashboard-page .dashboard-header.is-scrolled .dashboard-profile-link:hover {
   color: var(--color-cyan-100);
   text-decoration: underline;
}

.dashboard-header .header-content {
   display: flex;
   justify-content: space-between;
   align-items: center;
}

.dashboard-header .brand-block {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-5);
}

.dashboard-header .logo-main {
   width: 76px;
   height: 76px;
   background: var(--color-white);
   padding: var(--spacing-2);
   border-radius: var(--radius-md);
   object-fit: contain;
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
   transition: all var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.dashboard-header .dashboard-title {
   color: var(--color-white);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   font-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-tight);
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-1);
   transition: all var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.dashboard-header .header-subtitle {
   max-width: 820px;
   color: var(--color-text-inverse);
   opacity: 0.92;
   font-size: var(--font-size-base);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
   margin: var(--spacing-1) 0 0;
   transition: all var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
   .dashboard-header {
      padding: var(--spacing-md) 0;
      border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg);
   }

   .dashboard-header .header-content {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--spacing-4);
      text-align: center;
   }

   .dashboard-header .brand-block {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--spacing-3);
   }

   .dashboard-header.is-scrolled .header-content {
      gap: var(--spacing-2);
   }

   .dashboard-header .dashboard-title {
      font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
   }

   .dashboard-header .header-subtitle {
      font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
      line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 100%;
   }
   
   .dashboard-header.is-scrolled .header-subtitle {
      display: none;
   }

   .dashboard-page .dashboard-nav-links {
      gap: var(--spacing-3);
      justify-content: center;
      width: 100%;
   }

   .dashboard-page #notificationDropdown {
      position: fixed;
      top: clamp(6.5rem, 15vh, 8.5rem);
      left: 50%;
      right: auto;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: min(95vw, 380px);
      max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem);
      max-height: calc(100dvh - 12rem);
      overflow-y: auto;
      z-index: 2000;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white) 85%, transparent);
   }
}

/* Reset para escritorio: Asegurar anclaje original en pantallas > 768px */
@media (min-width: 769px) {
   .dashboard-page #notificationDropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      right: 0;
      left: auto;
      transform: none;
      width: 320px;
      margin-top: 10px;
      z-index: 100;
      background: var(--color-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
   }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
   .dashboard-header .logo-main {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
   }

.dashboard-header .dashboard-title {
       font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
    }
}


.quick-module-nav-wrap {
    max-width: 1120px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 var(--spacing-lg) var(--spacing-1);
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.quick-module-nav {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    column-gap: clamp(var(--spacing-xl), 9vw, calc(var(--spacing-2xl) + var(--spacing-xl)));
    row-gap: var(--spacing-1);
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.quick-module-nav__link {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 28px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.1vw, 1.15rem);
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 0 0 var(--spacing-1);
    transition: color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.quick-module-nav__link:hover,
.quick-module-nav__link:focus-visible {
    color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
}

.quick-module-nav__link:focus-visible {
    outline: var(--border-width-2) solid var(--color-border-focus);
    outline-offset: 4px;
}

.quick-module-nav__link::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 3px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    background: var(--color-brand-secondary);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: center;
    transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.quick-module-nav__link:hover::after,
.quick-module-nav__link:focus-visible::after {
    transform: scaleX(1);
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .quick-module-nav-wrap {
        padding: 0 var(--spacing-md) var(--spacing-1);
    }

    .quick-module-nav {
        column-gap: var(--spacing-xl);
        row-gap: var(--spacing-1);
    }

    .quick-module-nav__link {
        min-height: 28px;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
    }
}


.content-wrapper,
.page-wrapper,
.forum-container {
   max-width: var(--size-content-readable);
   margin: var(--spacing-xl) auto var(--spacing-16);
   padding: 0 var(--spacing-md);
}

.lesson-card,
.activity-card,
.page-card,
.forum-shell {
   position: relative;
   overflow: hidden;
   padding: var(--spacing-16);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.lesson-title,
.activity-title,
.page-title {
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-lg);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-tight);
}

.section-title {
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-md);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.subsection-title {
   margin: var(--spacing-md) 0 var(--spacing-sm);
   color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.text-section {
   clear: both;
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-12);
}

.text-section::after {
   content: "";
   display: table;
   clear: both;
}

.content-list,
.content-list-ordered {
   margin: var(--spacing-md) 0 var(--spacing-xl);
   padding-left: var(--spacing-6);
}

.content-list li,
.content-list-ordered li {
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-3);
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.content-list li::marker,
.content-list-ordered li::marker {
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.highlight-box,
.privacy-note,
.reflection-card,
.quote-card {
   padding: var(--spacing-xl);
   margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0;
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
   border-radius: 0 var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0;
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.privacy-note,
.warning-box {
   border-left-color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
}

.prompt-block,
.prompt-example {
   margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
   padding: var(--spacing-lg);
   overflow-x: auto;
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
   white-space: pre-wrap;
}

/* ----- AUDIO ----- */
.audio-player-container {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   gap: var(--spacing-2);
   padding: var(--spacing-lg);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-10);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}

.audio-label {
   display: block;
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
   text-transform: uppercase;
}

.audio-player {
   width: 100%;
}

/* ----- MEDIA / IFRAMES ----- */
.video-wrapper {
   width: 100%;
   overflow: hidden;
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.video-frame-inner {
   position: relative;
   width: 100%;
   height: 0;
   padding-bottom: 56.25%;
}

.video-frame-inner iframe {
   position: absolute;
   inset: 0;
   width: 100%;
   height: 100%;
   border: 0;
}






/* ----- IMAGES / ZOOM ----- */
.image-zoom-trigger,
.info-img-container {
   display: block;
   width: 100%;
   padding: 0;
   overflow: hidden;
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
   cursor: zoom-in;
}

.image-zoom-trigger img,
.info-img-container img {
   width: 100%;
   display: block;
   transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.image-zoom-trigger:hover img,
.info-img-container:hover img {
   transform: scale(1.01);
}

.img-caption {
   margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

/* ----- MODAL ZOOM ----- */
.modal-zoom {
   position: fixed;
   inset: 0;
   z-index: 9999;
   display: none;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   padding: var(--spacing-6);
   background: var(--color-alpha-black-90);
}

.modal-zoom.is-open {
   display: flex;
}

.modal-content {
   position: relative;
   max-width: min(1100px, 95vw);
   max-height: 90vh;
}

.modal-content img {
   max-width: 100%;
   max-height: 90vh;
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
}

.modal-close-btn {
   position: absolute;
