   top: var(--spacing-3);
   right: var(--spacing-3);
   width: 44px;
   height: 44px;
   border: none;
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   background: var(--color-alpha-white-90);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   cursor: pointer;
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

/* ----- COMPLETION ----- */
.completion-card {
   margin-top: var(--spacing-16);
   padding: var(--spacing-xl);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   position: relative;
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.completion-badge {
   position: absolute;
   top: calc(-1 * var(--spacing-5));
   right: var(--spacing-xl);
   padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-5);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   background: var(--color-brand-primary);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
   text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ----- REFLECTION ACCORDION ----- */
.reflection-accordion {
   margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0;
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   overflow: hidden;
   background-color: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.reflection-accordion__header {
   width: 100%;
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: space-between;
   padding: var(--spacing-lg) var(--spacing-xl);
   background: var(--gradient-orange);
   color: var(--color-white);
   border: none;
   cursor: pointer;
   text-align: left;
   transition: filter var(--motion-duration-fast) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.reflection-accordion__header:hover {
   filter: brightness(1.05);
}

.reflection-accordion__header-content {
   flex: 1;
}

.reflection-accordion__label {
   display: block;
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   text-transform: uppercase;
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-1);
   opacity: 0.9;
}

.reflection-accordion__question {
   display: block;
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.reflection-accordion__action-text {
   display: block;
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   text-transform: uppercase;
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wider);
   margin-top: var(--spacing-sm);
   opacity: 0.85;
   transition: opacity var(--motion-duration-fast) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.reflection-accordion__header:hover .reflection-accordion__action-text {
   opacity: 1;
}

.reflection-accordion__icon {
   margin-left: var(--spacing-md);
   transition: transform var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-standard);
   flex-shrink: 0;
}

.reflection-accordion__header[aria-expanded="true"] .reflection-accordion__icon {
   transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.reflection-accordion__content {
   display: grid;
   grid-template-rows: 0fr;
   transition: grid-template-rows var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-standard);
   background-color: var(--color-background-surface-low);
}

.reflection-accordion__header[aria-expanded="true"] + .reflection-accordion__content {
   grid-template-rows: 1fr;
}

.reflection-accordion__inner {
   overflow: hidden;
   padding: 0 var(--spacing-xl);
}

.reflection-accordion__body {
   padding: var(--spacing-lg) 0;
}

.reflection-accordion__context {
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
}

.reflection-accordion__note {
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   font-style: italic;
   padding-top: var(--spacing-md);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
}


/* ----- REFERENCES / BIBLIOGRAPHY ----- */
.references-section {
   margin-top: var(--spacing-16);
   padding: var(--spacing-xl);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.references-section h2 {
   margin-top: 0;
}

.ref-list {
   margin: 0;
   padding-left: var(--spacing-6);
}

.ref-list li {
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-3);
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.biblio-list {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   gap: var(--spacing-lg);
   margin-top: var(--spacing-xl);
}

.biblio-item {
   padding: var(--spacing-xl);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
   transition:
      transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.biblio-item:hover {
   transform: translateY(-5px);
   border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.biblio-tag {
   display: inline-block;
   width: fit-content;
   padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
   text-transform: uppercase;
}

.biblio-title {
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.biblio-citation,
.biblio-summary {
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.biblio-summary {
   padding-top: var(--spacing-md);
   margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
}

.biblio-actions {
   display: flex;
   flex-wrap: wrap;
   gap: var(--spacing-sm);
   margin-top: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.btn-biblio,
.btn-resource,
.btn-download {
   display: inline-flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-2);
   padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   text-decoration: none;
   transition:
      background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.btn-biblio:hover,
.btn-resource:hover,
.btn-download:hover {
   transform: translateY(-2px);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.btn-biblio-pdf,
.btn-download.is-primary,
.btn-resource.is-primary {
   background: var(--color-brand-primary);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
   border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

/* ----- FOOTER NAV ----- */
.footer-nav {
   display: flex;
   justify-content: space-between;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-md);
   margin-top: var(--spacing-16);
   padding-top: var(--spacing-xl);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
}

.btn-footer {
   display: inline-flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-2);
   padding: var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-xl);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   text-decoration: none;
   transition:
      transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.btn-back {
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.btn-back:hover {
   transform: translateX(-5px);
}

.btn-next {
   background: var(--color-background-button-primary-default);
   color: var(--color-text-button-primary-default);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-secondary);
}

.btn-next:hover {
   transform: translateX(5px);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

/* ----- SCROLL TOP ----- */
.btn-scroll-top {
   position: fixed;
   right: var(--spacing-lg);
   bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
   z-index: 100;
   width: 50px;
   height: 50px;
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   background: var(--color-brand-primary);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
   text-decoration: none;
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
   opacity: 0;
   visibility: hidden;
   transition:
      opacity var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      visibility var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
      transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.btn-scroll-top.visible {
   opacity: 1;
   visibility: visible;
}

.btn-scroll-top:hover {
   transform: translateY(-3px);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   COMPONENT: PADLET CTA (CALL TO ACTION)
   Institutional standard for external Padlet links
   ========================================================================== */

.padlet-cta {
   position: relative;
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-top: 4px solid var(--color-brand-primary);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   background-color: var(--color-background-surface);
   padding: var(--spacing-xl);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
   transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
               box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
   margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0;
   overflow: hidden;
}

.padlet-cta:hover {
   transform: translateY(-4px);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.padlet-cta__header {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   gap: var(--spacing-1);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.padlet-cta__label {
   display: inline-block;
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   text-transform: uppercase;
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wider);
}

.padlet-cta__title {
   margin: 0;
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
}

.padlet-cta__description {
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-base);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
}

/* Steps Scaffolding (Compact Variant) */
.padlet-cta__steps {
   display: grid;
   gap: var(--spacing-3);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xl);
   padding: var(--spacing-lg);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}

.padlet-cta__step {
   display: flex;
   gap: var(--spacing-md);
   align-items: center;
}

.padlet-cta__step-number {
   flex-shrink: 0;
   width: 28px;
   height: 28px;
   background: var(--color-brand-primary);
   color: var(--color-white);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
}

.padlet-cta__step-text {
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   color: var(--color-text-primary);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
}

.padlet-cta__footer {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-sm);
   padding-top: var(--spacing-lg);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) dashed var(--color-border-default);
}

.padlet-cta__button-icon {
   margin-left: var(--spacing-xs);
   transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.btn:hover .padlet-cta__button-icon {
   transform: translateX(4px);
}

.padlet-cta__note {
   display: block;
   margin-top: var(--spacing-sm);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
   text-align: center;
}

/* ----- RESPONSIVE EDUCATIVO ----- */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

   .content-wrapper,
   .page-wrapper,
   .forum-container {
      padding: 0 var(--spacing-4);
   }

   .lesson-card,
   .activity-card,
   .page-card,
   .forum-shell,
   .references-section,
   .padlet-cta {
      padding: var(--spacing-xl);
   }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {

   .lesson-title,
   .activity-title,
   .page-title {
      font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
   }

   .top-nav {
      padding: 0 var(--spacing-4);
   }

   .module-title-nav {
      max-width: 58vw;
      font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   }

   .footer-nav {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
      text-align: center;
   }
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
   :root {
      --size-module-sidebar-width: 86vw;
   }

   .module-title-nav {
      display: none;
   }

   .lesson-card,
   .activity-card,
   .page-card,
   .forum-shell,
   .references-section,
   .biblio-item,
   .padlet-cta {
      padding: var(--spacing-md);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
   }
}

/* ----- GENIALLY CHECKPOINT (V3) ----- */
.genially-checkpoint {
   margin: var(--spacing-16) 0;
   padding: var(--spacing-8);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-top: var(--border-width-4) solid var(--color-brand-secondary);
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated);
}

.genially-checkpoint__eyebrow {
   display: block;
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-1);
   color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   text-transform: uppercase;
   letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wider);
}

.genially-checkpoint__title {
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-2);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
}

.genially-checkpoint__description {
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-6);
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.genially-checkpoint__actions {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   align-items: flex-start;
   gap: var(--spacing-4);
}

.genially-checkpoint__fallback {
   display: inline-flex;
   padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-6);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   text-decoration: none;
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.genially-checkpoint__fallback:hover {
   background: var(--color-brand-primary);
   color: var(--color-white);
}

.genially-checkpoint__note {
   margin-top: var(--spacing-2);
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
   font-style: italic;
}

.genially-checkpoint__panel {
   margin-top: var(--spacing-8);
   padding-top: var(--spacing-8);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   animation: slide-up var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-standard) both;
}

.genially-checkpoint__frame-wrap {
   position: relative;
   width: 100%;
   height: 0;
   padding-bottom: 56.25%;
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   border-radius: var(--radius-md);
   overflow: hidden;
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.genially-checkpoint__frame-wrap iframe {
   position: absolute;
   inset: 0;
   width: 100%;
   height: 100%;
   border: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
   .genially-checkpoint {
      padding: var(--spacing-6);
   }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   COMPONENT — CONCEPT REVIEW (Alt E3)
   Panel colapsado + micro-repaso progresivo adaptativo.
   Usa <details>/<summary> nativo para accesibilidad sin JS.
   ========================================================================== */

.concept-review {
   margin: var(--spacing-16) 0;
   padding: var(--spacing-6);
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
}

.concept-review > .concept-review__summary-main {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-4);
   flex-wrap: wrap;
   padding: var(--spacing-2);
   cursor: pointer;
   list-style: none;
}

.concept-review > .concept-review__summary-main::-webkit-details-marker {
   display: none;
}

.concept-review__icon {
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
   line-height: 1;
}

.concept-review__meta {
   flex: 1;
   min-width: 0;
}

.concept-review__title {
   margin: 0;
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-display);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.concept-review__subtitle {
   margin: var(--spacing-1) 0 0;
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.concept-review__count {
   display: inline-flex;
   align-items: center;
   padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
   background: var(--color-brand-primary-container);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-active);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
   white-space: nowrap;
}

.concept-review__panel {
   margin-top: var(--spacing-4);
}

.concept-review__list {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   gap: var(--spacing-3);
}

.concept-review__item {
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
   overflow: hidden;
}

.concept-review__item[open] {
   border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.concept-review__summary {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   gap: var(--spacing-3);
   padding: var(--spacing-4);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-display);
   cursor: pointer;
   list-style: none;
   transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-instant);
}

.concept-review__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
   display: none;
}

.concept-review__summary::before {
   content: "▸";
   flex-shrink: 0;
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   color: var(--color-text-disabled);
   transition: transform var(--motion-duration-instant);
}

.concept-review__item[open] > .concept-review__summary::before {
   transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.concept-review__summary:hover {
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
}

.concept-review__body {
   padding: 0 var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-4);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
}

.concept-review__body p {
   margin: var(--spacing-3) 0 0;
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.concept-review__citation {
   display: block;
   margin-top: var(--spacing-3);
   padding-top: var(--spacing-2);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-style: italic;
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.concept-review__more {
   display: block;
   width: 100%;
   margin-top: var(--spacing-3);
   padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-4);
   background: transparent;
   color: var(--color-text-link);
   border: var(--border-width-1) dashed var(--color-brand-primary);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
   cursor: pointer;
   transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-instant),
               color var(--motion-duration-instant);
}

.concept-review__more:hover {
   background: var(--color-brand-primary-container);
   color: var(--color-brand-primary-display);
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
   .concept-review {
      padding: var(--spacing-4);
   }
   .concept-review > .concept-review__summary-main {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: var(--spacing-2);
   }
   .concept-review__count {
      align-self: flex-start;
   }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   References Compact — Referencias
   ========================================================================== */
.references-compact {
   margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0;
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
   overflow: hidden;
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.references-compact__summary {
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: space-between;
   flex-wrap: wrap;
   gap: var(--spacing-sm);
   padding: var(--spacing-md) var(--spacing-lg);
   cursor: pointer;
   list-style: none;
   background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
   transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default);
}

.references-compact__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
   display: none;
}

.references-compact__summary:hover {
   background: var(--color-background-surface-medium);
}

.references-compact__summary:focus-visible {
   outline: var(--border-width-2) solid var(--color-border-focus);
   outline-offset: -2px;
}

.references-compact__title {
   color: var(--color-text-display);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.references-compact__count {
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-2);
   border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
   margin-right: auto;
   margin-left: var(--spacing-md);
}

.references-compact__action {
   color: var(--color-brand-primary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
   text-decoration: underline;
   text-decoration-color: transparent;
   transition: text-decoration-color var(--motion-duration-default);
}

.references-compact__summary:hover .references-compact__action {
   text-decoration-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.references-compact[open] .references-compact__action {
   font-size: 0;
}

.references-compact[open] .references-compact__action::after {
   content: "Ocultar referencias";
   font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.references-compact__body {
   padding: var(--spacing-lg);
   border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
}

.references-compact__body ul, 
.references-compact__body ol {
   margin: 0;
   padding-left: var(--spacing-lg);
   overflow-wrap: break-word;
   word-break: break-word;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
   .references-compact__summary {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
   }
   .references-compact__count {
      margin-left: 0;
      margin-top: var(--spacing-xs);
   }
   .references-compact__action {
      align-self: flex-end;
   }
}

.intro-layout-sidebar {
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
   gap: var(--spacing-4);
}

/* ========================================================================== 
   RESEARCHER MINI PROFILE — DASHBOARD
   ========================================================================== */

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-2);
  padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__eyebrow {
  margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  line-height: 1.05;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__name {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.08;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__meta {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.08rem;
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__meta p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  line-height: 1.16;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__details {
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  padding-top: 0.25rem;
  border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--spacing-1);
  outline: none;
  transition: color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__summary::before {
  content: "►";
  font-size: 0.8em;
  transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__details[open] .researcher-mini-profile__summary::before {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__summary:hover,
.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__summary:focus-visible {
  color: var(--color-brand-primary-hover);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__summary:focus-visible {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__more {
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  animation: fade-in var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.dashboard-page .researcher-mini-profile .researcher-mini-profile__more p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  line-height: 1.22;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Book Creator Resource — Recursos Módulo 1
   ========================================================================== */
.bookcreator-resource {
   display: flex;
   gap: var(--spacing-xl);
   padding: var(--spacing-xl);
   background: var(--color-background-surface);
   border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
   border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-16);
   transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
   align-items: center;
}

.bookcreator-resource:hover {
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated);
}

.bookcreator-resource__cover {
   flex: 0 0 240px;
   max-width: 240px;
}

.bookcreator-resource__cover img {
   width: 100%;
   height: auto;
   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
   box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated);
   display: block;
   transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.bookcreator-resource:hover .bookcreator-resource__cover img {
   transform: scale(1.02);
}

.bookcreator-resource__content {
   flex: 1;
   display: flex;
   flex-direction: column;
}

.bookcreator-resource__title {
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-2);
   color: var(--color-text-display);
   font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
   font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
   font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
   line-height: 1.2;
}

.bookcreator-resource__description {
   margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-lg);
   color: var(--color-text-secondary);
   font-size: var(--font-size-base);
   line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.bookcreator-resource__actions {
   margin-bottom: var(--spacing-2);
}

.bookcreator-resource__note {
   margin: 0;
   color: var(--color-text-muted);
   font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
   font-style: italic;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
   .bookcreator-resource {
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: var(--spacing-lg);
      gap: var(--spacing-lg);
      text-align: center;
   }

   .bookcreator-resource__cover {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      max-width: 180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
   }

   .bookcreator-resource__content {
      align-items: center;
   }

   .bookcreator-resource__title {
      font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
   }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Compact Bibliographic Resources — Módulos M1, M2, M3
   ========================================================================== */
.compact-biblio-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-sm);
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.compact-biblio-item {
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
}

.compact-biblio-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.compact-biblio-item[open] {
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.compact-biblio-summary-trigger {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-6);
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
}

.compact-biblio-summary-trigger::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.compact-biblio-title-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-1);
  flex: 1;
}

.compact-biblio-tag {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.compact-biblio-name {
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.compact-biblio-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  margin-left: var(--spacing-4);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.compact-biblio-item[open] .compact-biblio-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  background: var(--color-brand-primary);
  color: white;
}

.compact-biblio-content {
  padding: 0 var(--spacing-6) var(--spacing-6) var(--spacing-6);
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-border-default);
  margin-top: -2px;
  animation: biblioSlideDown 0.3s ease-out;
}

@keyframes biblioSlideDown {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.compact-biblio-apa {
  margin: var(--spacing-4) 0;
  padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.compact-biblio-description {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-4) 0;
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.compact-biblio-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding-top: var(--spacing-4);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border-default);
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .compact-biblio-summary-trigger {
    padding: var(--spacing-4);
  }
  
  .compact-biblio-name {
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  }
  
  .compact-biblio-content {
    padding: 0 var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-4);
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Bibliographic Resources Compact — Recursos
   Panel exterior colapsable + tarjetas compactas con cita visible
   ========================================================================== */

.bibliographic-resources {
  margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0;
}

.bibliographic-resources__panel {
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.bibliographic-resources__panel[open] {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated);
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.bibliographic-resources__summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--spacing-md);
  padding: var(--spacing-lg) var(--spacing-xl);
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
  user-select: none;
}

.bibliographic-resources__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.bibliographic-resources__summary:hover {
  background: var(--color-background-surface-medium);
}

.bibliographic-resources__summary:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--border-width-2) solid var(--color-border-focus);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.bibliographic-resources__summary-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
}

.bibliographic-resources__summary-text {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.bibliographic-resources__title {
  display: block;
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.bibliographic-resources__count {
  display: block;
  margin-top: var(--spacing-1);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
}

.bibliographic-resources__action {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--spacing-1);
  padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-5);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
    color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
    border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.bibliographic-resources__panel[open] .bibliographic-resources__action {
  background: var(--color-brand-primary);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.bibliographic-resources__arrow {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.bibliographic-resources__panel[open] .bibliographic-resources__arrow {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.bibliographic-resources__list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-sm);
  padding: var(--spacing-xl);
  border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
}

.bibliographic-resource {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--spacing-4);
  padding: var(--spacing-4) var(--spacing-5);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  transition: border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
    box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.bibliographic-resource:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.bibliographic-resource__main {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.bibliographic-resource__tag {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-1);
  padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
}

.bibliographic-resource__title {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-2);
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.bibliographic-resource__citation {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-2);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.bibliographic-resource__details {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
}

.bibliographic-resource__details summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
  padding: var(--spacing-1) 0;
}

.bibliographic-resource__details summary:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.bibliographic-resource__details summary:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--border-width-2) solid var(--color-border-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--spacing-1);
}

.bibliographic-resource__details p {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-2);
  padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-3);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.bibliographic-resource__actions {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.bibliographic-resource__actions .btn {
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-4);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .bibliographic-resources__summary {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .bibliographic-resources__action {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .bibliographic-resource {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--spacing-3);
  }

  .bibliographic-resource__actions {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .bibliographic-resource__actions .btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .bibliographic-resources__list {
    padding: var(--spacing-4);
  }

  .bibliographic-resource {
    padding: var(--spacing-3);
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Prompt Bank — Banco de Prompts Interactivo
   ========================================================================== */

/* Outer shell - collapsed by default */
.prompt-bank-shell {
  margin: var(--spacing-xl) 0;
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
    border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.prompt-bank-shell[open] {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated);
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.prompt-bank-shell__summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-2);
  padding: var(--spacing-lg) var(--spacing-xl);
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
  user-select: none;
}

.prompt-bank-shell__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.prompt-bank-shell__summary:hover {
  background: var(--color-background-surface-medium);
}

.prompt-bank-shell__summary:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--border-width-2) solid var(--color-border-focus);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.prompt-bank-shell__eyebrow {
  font-size: var(--font-size-2xs);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wider);
}

.prompt-bank-shell__title {
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.prompt-bank-shell__description {
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
  max-width: 640px;
}

.prompt-bank-shell__meta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: fit-content;
  padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
  background: var(--color-brand-primary-container);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary-active);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
}

.prompt-bank-shell__action {
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: var(--spacing-1);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: transparent;
  transition: text-decoration-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.prompt-bank-shell__summary:hover .prompt-bank-shell__action {
  text-decoration-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.prompt-bank-shell[open] .prompt-bank-shell__action {
  font-size: 0;
}

.prompt-bank-shell[open] .prompt-bank-shell__action::after {
  content: "Cerrar banco";
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Prompt bank body (inside shell) */
.prompt-bank {
  padding: var(--spacing-xl);
  border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-md);
}

.prompt-bank__toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-md);
}

.prompt-bank__search-wrap {
  width: 100%;
}

.prompt-bank__label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-1);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

.prompt-bank__search {
  width: 100%;
}

.prompt-bank__ethics-note {
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}

.prompt-bank__filters {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--spacing-1);
  align-items: center;
}

.prompt-bank__filter {
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-4);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-family-body);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  transition: all var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.prompt-bank__filter:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.prompt-bank__filter.is-active {
  background: var(--color-brand-primary);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary-on);
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.prompt-bank__status {
  min-height: 1.5em;
  color: var(--color-feedback-success-on);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--spacing-2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--color-feedback-success-container);
  transition: opacity var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.prompt-bank__status:empty {
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

.prompt-bank__grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-md);
}

.prompt-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--spacing-3);
  padding: var(--spacing-md) var(--spacing-lg);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  transition: box-shadow var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard),
    border-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.prompt-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.prompt-card.is-expanded {
  border-color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.prompt-card__header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--spacing-3);
}

.prompt-card__tag {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: var(--spacing-1);
}

.prompt-card__title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.prompt-card__description {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.prompt-card__details {
  margin: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
}

.prompt-card__summary {
  display: block;
  padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-3);
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  user-select: none;
  transition: background-color var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.prompt-card__summary:hover {
  background: var(--color-brand-primary-container);
}

.prompt-card__summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.prompt-card__summary::before {
  content: "\25B6";
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: var(--spacing-1);
  font-size: 0.65em;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  transition: transform var(--motion-duration-default) var(--motion-easing-standard);
}

.prompt-card__details[open] .prompt-card__summary::before {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.prompt-card__prompt {
  padding: var(--spacing-4);
  border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  line-height: 1.6;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: normal;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  text-align: left;
  hyphens: none;
  max-height: min(55vh, 480px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
}

.prompt-card__reader-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--spacing-2);
  padding: var(--spacing-3) var(--spacing-4);
  border-top: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
}

.prompt-card__copy {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 40px;
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-4);
}

.prompt-card__copy:disabled {
  background: var(--color-feedback-success);
  color: var(--color-white);
  cursor: default;
  transform: none;
  box-shadow: none;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.prompt-card__close {
  min-height: 40px;
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-4);
}

.prompt-bank__empty {
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--spacing-12) var(--spacing-md);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  border: var(--border-width-1) dashed var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .prompt-bank-shell__summary {
    padding: var(--spacing-md) var(--spacing-lg);
  }

  .prompt-bank {
    padding: var(--spacing-md);
  }

  .prompt-bank__filter {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
    min-height: 32px;
  }

  .prompt-card {
    padding: var(--spacing-sm) var(--spacing-md);
  }

  .prompt-card__header {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--spacing-2);
  }

  .prompt-card__reader-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .prompt-card__prompt {
    max-height: min(50vh, 360px);
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   DOCENCIA 4.0 — LESSON EDITORIAL FLEX SYSTEM
   Componentes flexibles para lecciones rediseñadas.
   No sustituye tokens globales ni altera componentes existentes.
   ========================================================= */

/* --- Floating Shell --- */
.lesson-floating-shell {
  width: min(100%, 1180px);
  margin: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem) auto var(--spacing-12);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-2xl);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  padding: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  overflow: visible;
  position: relative;
}

.lesson-floating-shell > :first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
}

/* --- Lesson Section --- */
.lesson-section {
  margin-block: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.25rem);
}

.lesson-section + .lesson-section {
  margin-top: clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem);
}

/* --- Split Layout (texto + imagen) --- */
.lesson-split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(280px, 0.85fr);
  gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  align-items: start;
}

.lesson-split.reverse {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr);
}

.lesson-split .section-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* --- Media Card --- */
.lesson-media-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 460px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-2xl);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  text-align: center;
  cursor: zoom-in;
  transition: transform var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-in-out),
              box-shadow var(--motion-duration-normal) var(--motion-easing-in-out);
}

.lesson-media-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

.lesson-media-card img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  max-height: clamp(220px, 34vw, 340px);
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-xl);
}

.lesson-media-card figcaption {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* --- Compact Note --- */
.lesson-compact-note {
  padding: var(--spacing-lg);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  border-left: var(--border-width-4) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
  border-radius: 0 var(--border-radius-lg) var(--border-radius-lg) 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  margin: var(--spacing-lg) 0;
}

/* --- Responsive --- */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .lesson-floating-shell {
    margin-top: 2rem;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 2.5rem) var(--spacing-6);
    border-radius: var(--border-radius-xl);
  }

  .lesson-split,
  .lesson-split.reverse {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--spacing-4);
  }

  .lesson-split .section-copy {
    order: 1;
  }

  .lesson-split .lesson-media-card {
    order: 2;
  }

  .lesson-media-card {
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: 0.65rem;
  }

  .lesson-media-card img {
    max-height: none;
  }

  .lesson-section {
    margin-block: 1.75rem;
  }

  .lesson-section + .lesson-section {
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .lesson-section {
    padding: 0 var(--spacing-4);
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   DOCENCIA 4.0 — LESSON ROLE TRANSFER CARDS
   Componente editorial progresivo para conexión con rol docente
   ========================================================= */

.lesson-role-transfer {
  width: 100%;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__intro {
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 0 clamp(1.5rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.15vw, 1.12rem);
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--color-text-body, #2f3b4a);
}

.lesson-role-transfer__grid {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  align-items: flex-start !important;
  gap: clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.75rem) !important;
  width: 100%;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__card {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex: 1 1 calc((100% - 3.5rem) / 3);
  min-width: min(100%, 17rem);
  max-width: 100%;
  align-self: flex-start !important;
  height: auto !important;
  min-height: clamp(17rem, 24vw, 19rem);
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 2rem);
  border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 1.5rem);
  background: var(--color-surface-soft, #eef3f7);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08));
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06));
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: normal;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary, #00aeef);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading, inherit);
  font-size: clamp(1.18rem, 1.45vw, 1.45rem);
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__hook {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-body, #2f3b4a);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.15vw, 1.12rem);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__details {
  margin-top: auto;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__details[open] {
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__details summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary, #00aeef);
  font-weight: 800;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 0.18em;
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__details summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__less {
  display: none;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__details[open] .lesson-role-transfer__more {
  display: none;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__details[open] .lesson-role-transfer__less {
  display: inline;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__body {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  color: var(--color-text-body, #2f3b4a);
  font-size: clamp(0.96rem, 1.05vw, 1.05rem);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.lesson-role-transfer__body p {
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .lesson-role-transfer__card {
    flex-basis: calc((100% - 1.75rem) / 2);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .lesson-role-transfer__grid {
    gap: 1rem !important;
  }

  .lesson-role-transfer__card {
    flex-basis: 100%;
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 1.35rem;
  }

  .lesson-role-transfer__intro,
  .lesson-role-transfer__hook,
  .lesson-role-transfer__body {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   DOCENCIA 4.0 — MODULE INTRO EDITORIAL SYSTEM
   Soporte visual para introducciones de módulo
   ========================================================= */

.module-intro-shell {
  max-width: 1080px;
}

.module-intro-card {
  display: block;
}

.module-section {
  margin-block: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.25rem);
}

.module-section-title {
  margin: 0 0 clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 2.2vw, 2rem);
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.module-section-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.module-key-message,
.module-objective-card,
.module-closing-card,
.module-audio-block,
.module-role-reminder {
  margin-block: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.module-key-message {
  border-left: var(--border-width-4) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.module-key-message__text,
.module-objective-card p,
.module-closing-card p,
.module-audio-block p,
.module-role-reminder p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--line-height-loose);
}

.module-learning-route,
.module-research-pillars,
.module-role-transfer {
  margin-block: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.25rem);
}

.module-route-grid,
.module-research-grid,
.module-role-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr));
  gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
  align-items: start;
}

.module-progressive-card {
  padding: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  align-self: start;
}

.module-progressive-card summary {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--spacing-sm);
  align-items: flex-start;
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
}

.module-progressive-card summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.module-progressive-card[open] {
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
}

.module-route-card__title {
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.module-route-card__cue {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 0.18em;
}

.module-progressive-card .summary-less {
  display: none;
}

.module-progressive-card[open] .summary-more {
  display: none;
}

.module-progressive-card[open] .summary-less {
  display: inline;
}

.module-progressive-card__body {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--line-height-loose);
}

.module-progressive-card__body p {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
}

.module-progressive-card__body p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.module-progressive-card__body ul {
  margin: var(--spacing-sm) 0 0;
  padding-left: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.module-progressive-card__body li {
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xs);
}

.module-outcomes-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--spacing-sm);
  margin: var(--spacing-md) 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.module-outcomes-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding: var(--spacing-sm) var(--spacing-md) var(--spacing-sm) calc(var(--spacing-md) + 1.25rem);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.module-outcomes-list li::before {
  content: "✓";
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--spacing-md);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.module-audio-block .audio-container {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .module-route-grid,
  .module-research-grid,
  .module-role-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .module-progressive-card summary {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .module-route-card__cue {
    margin-top: var(--spacing-xs);
  }

  .module-key-message,
  .module-objective-card,
  .module-closing-card,
  .module-audio-block,
  .module-role-reminder,
  .module-progressive-card {
    padding: var(--spacing-md);
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   DOCENCIA 4.0 — LESSON 1.1 EDITORIAL ORGANIZATION SYSTEM
   Organización instruccional, UX/UI y carga cognitiva
   ========================================================= */

.lesson-audio-intro {
  margin-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
}

.lesson-audio-intro__text {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.lesson-editorial-section {
  clear: both;
  margin-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

.lesson-summary-card,
.lesson-core-callout,
.lesson-alert-callout,
.lesson-practical-rule,
.lesson-difference-callout,
.lesson-remember-card {
  margin-block: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.lesson-summary-card,
.lesson-core-callout {
  border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.lesson-alert-callout,
.lesson-practical-rule {
  border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-secondary);
}

.lesson-core-callout__label {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.lesson-split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(300px, 0.85fr);
  gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  align-items: start;
}

.lesson-split__content,
.lesson-split__media {
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-split .llm-interactive-card,
.lesson-split .img-editorial-right,
.lesson-split .img-editorial-left {
  float: none;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
}

.lesson-content-block {
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.lesson-content-block h3 {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-xs);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.lesson-quote-callout {
  font-style: normal;
}

.lesson-mini-card-grid,
.lesson-decision-grid,
.lesson-tools-grid,
.lesson-role-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
  gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
  margin-block: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  align-items: start;
}

.lesson-mini-card,
.lesson-decision-card,
.lesson-tool-card,
  .lesson-role-card {
    padding: var(--spacing-md);
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   DOCENCIA 4.0 — LECCIÓN 1.2 EDITORIAL ORGANIZATION SYSTEM
   UX/UI, DI y reducción de carga cognitiva por áreas
   ========================================================= */

.lesson-audio-intro {
    margin-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
}

.lesson-audio-intro__text {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.lesson-summary-card,
.lesson-core-callout,
.lesson-example-callout,
.lesson-practical-rule,
.lesson-remember-card {
    margin-block: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
    padding: clamp(1.25rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
    background: var(--color-background-surface-low);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.lesson-summary-card,
.lesson-core-callout,
.lesson-remember-card {
    border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-primary);
}

.lesson-example-callout,
.lesson-practical-rule {
    border-left: var(--border-width-6) solid var(--color-brand-secondary);
}

.lesson-core-callout__label,
.lesson-section-kicker {
    margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
    color: var(--color-brand-primary);
    font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-wide);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.lesson-area-section {
    clear: both;
    margin-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

.lesson-area-split {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(300px, 0.85fr);
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    align-items: start;
}

.lesson-area-split--reverse .lesson-area-content {
    order: 2;
}

.lesson-area-split--reverse .lesson-area-media {
    order: 1;
}

.lesson-area-content,
.lesson-area-media {
    min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-media-card {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--color-background-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.lesson-media-card img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
}

.lesson-media-caption {
    margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.lesson-progressive-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--spacing-md);
    margin-block: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
}

.lesson-progressive-card {
    padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
    background: var(--color-background-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.lesson-progressive-card summary {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--spacing-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    color: var(--color-text-display);
    font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.lesson-progressive-card summary::-webkit-details-marker {
    display: none;
}

.lesson-progressive-card .summary-more,
.lesson-progressive-card .summary-less {
    color: var(--color-brand-primary);
    font-family: var(--font-family-body);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.18em;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.lesson-progressive-card .summary-less,
details:not([open]) > summary .summary-less {
    display: none;
}

.lesson-progressive-card[open] .summary-more {
    display: none;
}

.lesson-progressive-card[open] .summary-less {
    display: inline;
}

.lesson-progressive-card__body {
    margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.lesson-progressive-card__body p:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.lesson-example-callout h3,
.lesson-practical-rule h3 {
    margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
    color: var(--color-brand-secondary);
    font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.lesson-role-transfer-section {
    margin-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

.lesson-role-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
    gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
    margin-top: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
    align-items: start;
}

.lesson-role-card {
    padding: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
    background: var(--color-background-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.lesson-role-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
    color: var(--color-brand-primary);
    font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
    line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.lesson-role-card p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    line-height: var(--line-height-relaxed);
}

.lesson-remember-card ul {
    margin: 0;
    padding-left: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.lesson-remember-card li {
    margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.concept-review__meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-width: 0;
}

.references-compact__summary {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
    .lesson-area-split,
    .lesson-area-split--reverse {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .lesson-area-split--reverse .lesson-area-content,
    .lesson-area-split--reverse .lesson-area-media {
        order: initial;
    }

    .lesson-progressive-card summary {
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .lesson-progressive-card .summary-more,
    .lesson-progressive-card .summary-less {
        margin-top: var(--spacing-xs);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .lesson-summary-card,
    .lesson-core-callout,
    .lesson-example-callout,
    .lesson-practical-rule,
    .lesson-remember-card,
    .lesson-progressive-card,
    .lesson-role-card {
        padding: var(--spacing-md);
    }
}

.lesson-mini-card h3,
.lesson-decision-card h4,
.lesson-tool-card h3,
.lesson-role-card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  line-height: var(--line-height-snug);
}

.lesson-mini-card p,
.lesson-decision-card p,
.lesson-tool-card p,
.lesson-role-card p {
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
}

.lesson-progressive-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--spacing-md);
  margin-block: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
}

.lesson-progressive-card {
  padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.lesson-progressive-card summary {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--spacing-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  color: var(--color-text-display);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.lesson-progressive-card summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.lesson-progressive-card .summary-more,
.lesson-progressive-card .summary-less {
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 0.18em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.lesson-progressive-card .summary-less {
  display: none;
}

.lesson-progressive-card[open] .summary-more {
  display: none;
}

.lesson-progressive-card[open] .summary-less {
  display: inline;
}

.lesson-progressive-card__body {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.lesson-progressive-card__body h4 {
  margin: var(--spacing-md) 0 var(--spacing-xs);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.lesson-media-card {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);

}

.lesson-media-card img {

  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.lesson-media-caption {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);

}

.lesson-practical-rule h3,
.lesson-difference-callout h3 {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-sm);
  color: var(--color-brand-secondary);

  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
}

.lesson-practical-rule ul,
.lesson-remember-card ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.lesson-practical-rule li,
.lesson-remember-card li {

.lesson-remember-card {

/* =========================================================
   DOCENCIA 4.0 — COMPONENTES REUTILIZABLES LMS
   Centralización de patrones repetidos de lecciones,
   actividades, foros, introducciones y recursos.
   ========================================================= */

/* 1. Lecciones */
.lesson-summary-card,
.lesson-objective-card,
.lesson-progressive-card,
.lesson-remember,
.lesson-role-connection,
.lesson-toolbox,
.lesson-media-card,
.concept-review,
.checkpoint-card,
.references-section {
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat);
}

.lesson-objective-card h2,
.lesson-objective-card h3 {
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
}

.lesson-progressive-summary {
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  color: var(--color-text-display);
}

.lesson-progressive-content {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-md);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.lesson-remember-item {
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.lesson-toolbox {
  background: var(--color-background-subtle);
  border-left: var(--border-width-4) solid var(--color-brand-secondary);
}

.lesson-toolbox-summary {
  font-family: var(--font-family-code);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  color: var(--color-text-display);
}

.lesson-meta-achieved {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
}

.checkpoint-iframe {
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: none;
}

.completion-section-wrap {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-2xl);
  text-align: center;
}

/* 2. Introducciones de módulo */
.module-intro-hero {
  text-align: center;

}

.module-reflection-card,

  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.module-learning-route {
  margin-top: var(--spacing-lg);
}

/* 3. Actividades */

.activity-ethics-card {

  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-ambient);
}

.activity-meta-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--spacing-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.activity-steps,
.padlet-steps-list {
  padding-left: var(--spacing-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.padlet-step-item {
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
}

.padlet-cta {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--color-brand-secondary);
  color: var(--color-background-base);
  padding: var(--spacing-sm) var(--spacing-lg);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.padlet-cta:hover {
  opacity: 0.9;
}

/* 4. Foros */
.forum-shell {
  max-width: var(--container-max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.forum-intro-card,
.forum-purpose-card,
.forum-participation-card,
.forum-reminder-card,
.forum-dynamic-section {
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.forum-alert {
  padding: var(--spacing-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
}

.forum-alert-warning {
  background-color: var(--color-feedback-warning-container);
  border-left: var(--border-width-4) solid var(--color-feedback-warning);
  color: var(--color-text-display);
}

.forum-guide-question {
  font-family: var(--font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  color: var(--color-brand-primary);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-extrabold);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);
}

/* 5. Recursos */
.resource-bank-shell {
  max-width: var(--container-max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.resource-summary-card,
.resource-guidance-card,
.resource-section-card,
.resource-video-card,
.resource-infographic-card,
.professional-kit-card,
.commitment-card {
  background: var(--color-background-surface);
  border: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
}

.resource-index {
  background: var(--color-background-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--spacing-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);

.bibliographic-resources {

.bibliographic-resource {

  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  border-bottom: var(--border-width-1) solid var(--color-border-subtle);

}

.professional-kit-grid {

  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));

}
